Sec. Aguilar refuses to bend the knee to Trump – even as this administration tries to intimidate him into compliance. His opponent, an election denier who wants to tear up Nevada's election system, would do exactly that for Trump in a heartbeat.

body:
This could be my last 4 weeks with you and the MAGA Movement.
| | | |
# **FAREWELL TO TRUMP**
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
This was hard to write.
**_In just 4 weeks, we might have to say goodbye to each other forever..._**
That’s if we lose the Congressional Majority on Election Night.
On day 1, Democrats will file the Articles of Impeachment against me for the THIRD TIME. But this time, they will have the votes — the votes to lock me out of the White House and throw away the key.
**_Could you even begin to fathom MAGA without Trump??_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Once they kick me out, they’ll reverse everything I’ve done to Make America Great Again over the past two years.
Borders will open and criminal illegal aliens will flood into our country AGAIN.
Cities like Washington DC will roar with crime AGAIN.
Social Security tax will go up to an all time high AGAIN.
And this time, the American dream might slip away for every young American and all future generations to come.
This will break my heart.
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
My job is far from over, and the last thing I want is for the Democrats to unleash terror on the great American people.
**_[So I am asking you, from the bottom of my heart, not to let them do it.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
You have stood with me when nobody else would. You have taken the hits, the insults, the lies, and you have never backed down. That’s why we’re still here. That’s why America still has a chance.
But four weeks is nothing. If our people sit this one out, it is over. No second chance. No do-over. They get the Majority, and they’ll obliterate all of the hard work that we’ve accomplished.
I need you in this fight. Not later. Now. One gift from you keeps our Majority alive and keeps me in this office, fighting for you.
Please. Do not make me say goodbye. Stand with me one more time.

[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Friends, I've seen and heard a lot of surprising things over the course of this campaign, but I think this is my first cease and desist letter. Roger Marshall is _so_ worried about an ad we put out, _so_ worried about Kansans seeing who he really is, that he actually had his lawyers try to bully us into taking it down.
Don't worry, we're doing no such thing. In fact, thanks to a surge of grassroots donations from folks like you in the past week, we're sharing it even farther and wider. Feel free to do the same.
In fact, you can check it out for yourself right now. For the record, **this is the ad Sen. Marshall REALLY doesn 't want you to see:**
[| | | | | Team Hamilton
---
@TeamHamiltonHQ
Meischa was Roger Marshall's patient. This is her story.
| 2:38 PM * Sep 25, 2026 * 1.08M Views113 Replies * 989 Reposts * 3.37K Likes
---](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c334e542-8247-48a4-892f-befa20934133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Roger Marshall and his lawyers can send all the cease and desist letters they want, but they can't change the fact that Meischa's story is true. And **Kansans deserve to know the truth about who they elect to represent them.**
You have to ask yourself: _Why is a former doctor and sitting senator so alarmed about people taking a closer look at his past? Or questioning him about his voting record in Congress? Why hasn 't he held a town hall meeting or had an open dialogue with Kansans in over 575 days?_
The answer is that he knows he's made extreme choices that have hurt individuals and communities across Kansas. In addition to what happened to Meischa, he voted to take away healthcare benefits from 63,000 Kansans.
I'm in this race because it's time for something different. Time for leaders who listen. Time to end the chaos and corruption in Washington. Time to bring Kansas values to the Senate and get to work solving the serious challenges our families are facing.
And with polls showing this race is neck and neck, we have a real opportunity to make that something different our reality. If you agree with me that we can and must do better, [please consider chipping in today to help us keep ads like this one on the air, reach even more folks across Kansas and finish this race strong.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/af73c4c0-af8a-4e10-bef0-ab2ff6b28dd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/af73c4c0-af8a-4e10-bef0-ab2ff6b28dd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks for all you do. We're in the final stretch, and I'm so grateful to have you with me.
Adam
P.S. You can read our response to Roger Marshall's attacks [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/63584583-e53b-490d-a0d5-23bf0ad7c1e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? Judicial Watch Wins Court Order for CIA January 6 Answers

[INSIDE JW]

FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS’ PHONE MESSAGES, DRONE DETAILS

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38807&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9FZ25sS2JJQXNoWT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=ee777d0b8c36579ecbbf1dcb87354436f78727c4bb4bddd3f9b18deb65c4ddd3

We are learning more about Thomas Crooks, the would-be assassin of
President Trump, but the FBI is sitting on much more.

We received 249 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38799&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=ff2af9bb4e08c0708d07a5d883ec9bb47852c41aea1b73f75938462d72f63f7d
of Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records through a Freedom of
Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit concerning Thomas Matthew Crooks, the
gunman who attempted to assassinate then-presidential candidate Donald
Trump at a July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania.

The records include photos taken of the Pittsburgh area by Crooks
using a drone, cell phone evidence that shows that Crooks received
fundraising appeals for Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA), a package
delivery from Hong Kong, and an unusual chat thread between Crooks and
an unidentified person.

We filed our July 2025 FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=35667&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=b6cbff8719bbdf30b0d4d392c8f0dc4822a578a1b7691b2d7d8dd5b2a2b6c0a9
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vXWFmdGVyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=967a9198564d8a37661353e6cfd2fca522a04df3879b5d2fef2482893a6f690f the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 request for records concerning
Crooks and the assassination attempt (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S.
Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=35650&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=ad3a5134b05ec3aa269b6709c44331474649a1173e7ccfb3604d4783654d6070

approximately 75,000 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38181&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYnV0bGVyLWFzc2Fzc2luYXRpb24tYXR0ZW1wdC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE].&H=aff3d6804016f59053b3fec363c3ff7e9b0eafef55ac263925f832523b97cbbd At
their current release rate of approximately 500 pages per month, it

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38800&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYtcGdzLTg2LTk0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=f0a3835f606509575225dd2db3e1729eac7eb88ce47c7adca078e96aefb832a5

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38806&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYtcGdzLTMtNDAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=2869b9ecffc498b1e2bfd0ec1ee674ac992313522ee6df8446f8865c73415810
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38801&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYtcGdzLTMtNDAvXXRpdGxlZD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=8bd6f4b2f4c17c01b064b6cf7fe89f6a3de8a0ad7009cd0f41af35f46e66d092

from then-U.S. Senate candidate Raphael Warnock and DHL shipment

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38802&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYtcGdzLTEwMS0xOTQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=38b966fd23a19e7d9f8b5deea84e6e34044d03b42e35ae2897ec9870004c7385

An FBI laboratory report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38803&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTktMDIyMTYtcGdzLTE5NS0yNTAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=a9b672998669835eb9fda348a0fb5b953924f861c12373b5faa35e771b468fb7

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=38804&F=T&],&H=4ae31e5de620424ead9ded13cfdf3df0c5e739a74c75e8fde09b71fe7c36f5c7

response to a Pennsylvania court order, an audio recording of a 911
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85807&L=37887&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3NpbHZhLXYtYmV0aGVsLXBhcmstcG9saWNlLWNyb29rcy1hdWRpby0wMDA2NzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=83d65770ce7c2b7159e7d5a2e76cff7372c7717843cc036e0c637d84dd1d5bbd

clean_body: Judicial Watch Wins Court Order for CIA January 6 Answers [INSIDE JW] FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS’ PHONE MESSAGES, DRONE DETAILS [ We are learning more about Thomas Crooks, the would-be assassin of President Trump, but the FBI is sitting on much more. We received 249 pages [ of Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit concerning Thomas Matthew Crooks, the gunman who attempted to assassinate then-presidential candidate Donald Trump at a July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. The records include photos taken of the Pittsburgh area by Crooks using a drone, cell phone evidence that shows that Crooks received fundraising appeals for Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA), a package delivery from Hong Kong, and an unusual chat thread between Crooks and an unidentified person. We filed our July 2025 FOIA lawsuit [ [ the FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 request for records concerning Crooks and the assassination attempt (Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice [ (No. 1:25-cv-02216)). The Justice Department has indicated that the total volume of records in the Crooks investigative file numbers approximately 75,000 pages [ At their current release rate of approximately 500 pages per month, it will take over 12 years to provide us with all the records. An FBI electronic communication [ dated July 19, 2024, concerns a cell phone conversation in the Crooks investigation described as a “chat thread” between Crooks and a recipient whose name is redacted. The conversation occurred between May 21, 2023, and January 3, 2024. The outgoing messages consist largely of one- and two-word messages or character strings, including: Hello Hello red Hello red Hdudhdbdbbd 7888ejdj Yolo Ddodjjf 890 Hdjd Djdj red Yup red Hello Jhhhuuh Hhdj Jjjjjjjjjjjj Hello red Red red ... The incoming messages are completely redacted from this text chain. A report [ [ “Samsung Messaging Review” is dated July 18, 2024, and details the FBI’s identification of other communications on a Crooks cell phone as “pertinent” to its investigation. FBI agents noted: Conversation with unknown contact [redacted] 8 February 2023 to 10 February 2023; Conversations with [redacted] 9 January 2023 to 16 January 2023; Conversations with [redacted] 12 December 2022 to 26 December 2022. The FBI also noted text messages consisting of campaign solicitations [ from then-U.S. Senate candidate Raphael Warnock and DHL shipment [ notifications from Hong Kong. Much of the new production consists of FBI laboratory analysis [ of a drone examined as part of the Crooks investigation. An FBI laboratory report [ dated July 19, 2024, details their technical exploitation of Thomas Crooks’ drone. They indicate they successfully extracted 40 images from the drone and eight flight logs. The images were taken between February 6, 2024, and February 27, 2024, in the Pittsburgh area. Seven of the eight flights occurred in the Allegheny-West, PA, area and an eighth flight on July 13, 2024, in the Butler, PA, area. The data pulled from the device indicates that it had been powered on 15 times. These latest records reveal more pieces of the puzzle surrounding Thomas Crooks. The FBI should stop the slow drip of heavily redacted records and immediately provide the full investigative record – especially since the death last week of James Copenhaver [ who was severely injured from being shot during the assassination attempt on President Trump. In September 2026, this lawsuit uncovered heavily redacted FBI records [ revealing that Crooks purchased “a chest rig and ceramic plates,” exhibited increasingly unusual behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues. In June 2026, this lawsuit forced the release of heavily redacted records [ from the FBI that indicated that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer at the July 2024 presidential rally for Donald Trump in Butler, PA, recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from Crooks’ pocket after he was killed. In May 2026, we received [ in response to a Pennsylvania court order, an audio recording of a 911 [ call placed by the father of Crooks [ In April 2026, our federal FOIA lawsuit forced the release of the first FBI records [ about the Butler assassination attempt, revealing that law enforcement personnel broadcast radio warnings about an “unknown male acting suspiciously” prior to the shooting. Also in April 2026, the lawsuit forced the release of records [ from the FBI that showed that Crooks was reportedly involved in an altercation with a group of people and making “hateful comments” directed at President Trump at the Butler, PA, rally. In August 2024, we uncovered [ documents under a Pennsylvania open record request from the district attorney’s office in Butler County, PA, detailing the extensive preparation of local police for the rally at which former President Trump was shot. The preparation included sniper teams, counter assault teams and a quick response force. In August 2024, in response to a Pennsylvania open records request, we obtained [ bodycam footage of the July 13 assassination events from the Butler Township Police Department. JUDGE ORDERS CIA TO PROVIDE ANSWERS ON JANUARY 6 RECORDS For more than two years the CIA has been stonewalling our request for information on its role at the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021. Now a federal judge has stepped in and [ [ the agency, beginning this week, to provide answers on its search for records. name: Chris Deluzio
subject: The cost of war
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
... continues well after the last service member returns home
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=100%2E42639%2EEgv7EN)
According to the Department of Veterans Affairs, there are more than 9.1 million veterans across the country who are enrolled to receive care from the VA.
That number includes me.
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261003&t=2&akid=100%2E42639%2EEgv7EN)
And if you ask my constituents or really any American whether or not they believe the VA should be there to care for veterans, they'll say, "Yes, absolutely."
But what is happening is that you have an administration and a compliant Republican Party that have -- for decades -- happily voted to send American kids to war but refuse to fund the care they need when they return home.
And in this administration, it's even worse.
This administration is slashing the VA from the inside.
In my district and in my region, Western Pennsylvania, more than 450 positions have been slashed according to some estimates.
In the fiscal year 2025 alone, more than 40,000 VA positions were cut.
That impacts care.
And for what?
Because by pushing veterans from the VA to privately run health care facilities there's a lot of money to be made and corporate executives see dollar signs. That may make a lot of money for some executives, but it would hurt our veterans.
I can anticipate your next question. Why does it matter where they are going to get care, if it's a VA health care facility or some private facility?
Most critically, at VA facilities we're talking about health care professionals who have the training and the history of caring for wounds, injuries, and conditions related to service. The kinds of physical and psychological traumas that are unique to service in wars.
Your local health care facility probably isn't treating a lot of victims of improvised explosive devices who have lost limbs, or been exposed to burn pits, or who have endured the psychological pain experienced in sustained life-or-death combat situations.
The truth is, the cost of war continues well after the last service member returns home. Politicians need to internalize that fact.
And this isn't just an "it's the right thing to do" situation. This is a military readiness question.
There's a quote often attributed to George Washington. It goes, "The willingness with which our young people are likely to serve in any war, no matter how justified, shall be directly proportional to how they perceive the Veterans of earlier wars were treated and appreciated by their nation."
Right now we have a Republican Party that is too quick to start forever wars but unwilling to pay the price for their misadventures.
That has to change when Democrats take back Congress in this election, and the White House in the next.
You can count on me to lead that effort.
Don't give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

But a new poll out this week -- one of the largest sample sizes we've seen -- shows Talarico's lead down to just 1 point. Inside the margin of error. Tightening, not widening. That's not an accident. Since September 1, Republicans have finally started matching Talarico dollar for dollar, putting over $100 million behind Paxton. The gap is closing because conservatives are showing up. Now I need you to show up too. Early voting starts October 19. We have just under 40 days to finish what we started in Cypress yesterday. ### Friends,
In just a few short months, the General Assembly will begin working on the the 2027 budget.

But the hundreds of pages and $46 billion that go along with it are only part of the story.

Our budget is a moral document. It serves as a record of where our state's priorities were during that time and place.

Which begs the immediate question, one that I have heard often, _where do our state's priorities lie? _

Too often that answer seems to be steeped in agendas and culture wars that do more harm than good,

My answer? Making the lives of the working families who call this state home more affordable and more dignified.

This means access to high quality child care so that parents have the ability to stay in the workforce if they choose.

It means Hoosier children and their grandparents both having access to healthcare.

It means a single mother being able to put food on the table _and_ keep the lights on.

Unfortunately, this is too far from reality for too many folks in our state.

But it doesn't have to be this way.

With this budget, we can change that, adn you should be involved every step of the way.

This is why the Indiana Senate Democrats started our statewide listening tour. To hear from you, and to inform the legislation that is drafted this upcoming session.

Thank you to all of those who have showed up so far to make your voice heard.

I am grateful to work alongside you in advocating for a state that our children can be proud of.

In Service,

**_State Senator Andrea Hunley_**
---
* * *
---
# _Standing with Hoosier Workers_
---
---
**BP locked out approximately 800 workers for more than six months. Now it 's challenging the unemployment benefits keeping their families afloat.** **This is corporate bullying. Hoosier families are not bargaining chips.** **I stand with USW Local 7-1. BP must withdraw its challenge and end the lockout.**
* * *
---
|
---
| To everyone who has come out to our statewide listening sessions: **thank you**. You have made time to ask thoughtful questions, share difficult experiences and speak up for your neighbors. That participation matters, and I am grateful. Our conversations have brought together concerns about rising utility bills, access to healthcare, the cost of housing and childcare, and the future of our schools and local services. In communities recovering from August's storms, rebuilding adds another layer of uncertainty. These concerns deserve our attention now, before we return to the Statehouse to write Indiana's next budget. My Senate Democratic colleagues and I are traveling across the state because representing Hoosiers requires hearing directly from them. Every community has its own needs, and we need to understand those differences as we work toward solutions. **We have three stops remaining:**
* **Elkhart: Saturday, Oct. 3**
* **Fort Wayne: Saturday, Oct. 10**
* **Portage: Saturday, Oct. 17**

If you are up for a road trip, I would love to see you there! Bring a friend, join the conversation and hear what fellow Hoosiers are experiencing in another part of our state. If you know someone who lives nearby, please pass along the invitation.

Come with your questions, your experiences and your hopes for Indiana. Our job is to listen and carry what we learn into the decisions ahead.
* * *
---
---
|
---
In the recent meeting of the Study Committee on Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, we heard testimony on the recent storms that caused devastation in Northwest Indiana.

In the aftermath of the storm, over 350,000 Hoosiers were without power, and some outages last nearly two weeks.

That is unacceptable.

I support my colleagues in Northwest Indiana who are calling for a thorough investigation of what happened, why it happened and to ensure that dollars earned through rate increases are being responsibly invested into the community.

If Hoosiers across the state are being burdened with electric bills that keep rising year after year, we should also expect reliability when it is needed most.

I am glad to see that this conversation is far from over, and I hope that the ratepayer is kept at the front of mind during the upcoming legislative session.
* * *
---
|
---
**Your Voice Matters. Register to Vote by _Oct. 5._** Throughout this newsletter, we have talked about decisions that affect your healthcare, your family's budget, our schools and our freedoms. Voting gives you a voice in choosing the people responsible for those decisions. Monday, Oct. 5, is Indiana's voter registration deadline for the Nov. 3 general election. If you need to register or update your registration, please act now. **Take a few minutes today:**
* [**Register or check your registration**](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTh9AA0AAAAAAVAcyELEKJQQ0GBsQ522iQ7A9XTHC6Z7wJeIH4mkZzpe7-GXeJrOAcoLEI8w4ozp3ToJScWm6jBJtoIFR8Di258qrXdV414SBysZ "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://indianavoters.in.gov/__;!!FlTQaCg!gq2QrOH5c5rPKEE-1Xr1tlwL_ZM1uLB-ALSqQLyyzei6enMBGqPGa8g0Voad_tX_OXR6f4z0v-CvzjOcxUwbcrcwO50$")**.** Confirm your name and address, especially if you have moved or changed your name.

Paper registration is also available.

Early voting begins Tuesday, Oct. 6. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3, with polls open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time. Make a plan for when and where you will vote. Please share this reminder with a friend, a neighbor or a student preparing to vote for the first time. Checking now gives you time to address a problem before the registration deadline.

---
**Medicaid Changes: Start Keeping Records Now** Changes under the federal "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" and Indiana's [_SEA 1, passed this year_](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTh9AA0AAAAAAVAcyELGihKDqjajWHUO56mIwYJjWilkUEOWQXbDPPzbMCqdV3tQTJVaT7UMN1BbiDQujVMF5ZYmxslRfHwGDCa6sqJm1J1cPP7e "https://iga.in.gov/legislative/2026/bills/senate/1/details"), are adding requirements for people who receive coverage through the Healthy Indiana Plan, or HIP. My immediate concern is making sure you know what is coming and where to get help. **Why October matters** The new requirements begin Jan. 1, 2027, but the state will look back at the preceding three months. If you apply in January, that means October, November and December. For current HIP members, the months reviewed depend on their renewal or work requirement review date. **Who is affected?** These rules generally apply to HIP adults ages 19-64 who are not exempt, rather than everyone receiving Medicaid. Qualifying options include 80 hours a month of work, volunteering or job training, school at least half time, or qualifying monthly income of at least $580. **Three things to do now**
1. **Keep a record for each month, starting in October.** Save pay stubs, time sheets, school records and volunteer or training confirmations. A notebook or phone note can help you track dates and hours. Keep copies of anything you submit.
2. **Ask whether you are exempt.** Pregnancy, caring for a child age 13 or younger or someone with a disability, and certain disabilities or medical conditions may qualify. Other exemptions exist. Ask FSSA what proof it needs before assuming your exemption is recorded.
3. **Check your contact information and notices.** Use the [_FSSA Benefits Portal_](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTh9AA0AAAAAAVAcyELHoDsb8qkK3aO9JBMEwJwX6sfCebnUyK8v3YlqCYpSsieInL5XHOL2QCDrXDinXU4lyFmyV8Su2EOGfFf0klQpGBuva1dw "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://fssabenefits.in.gov/__;!!FlTQaCg!gq2QrOH5c5rPKEE-1Xr1tlwL_ZM1uLB-ALSqQLyyzei6enMBGqPGa8g0Voad_tX_OXR6f4z0v-CvzjOcxUwbdIhxrq8$") to review your case and renewal date. Read every notice, mark its deadline and follow its instructions. Saving records does not replace submitting information when requested.

**Need help? Call 800-403-0864.** The Division of Family Resources can help with your case and submitting information. Ask: _" Do these rules apply to me? Am I exempt? Which months will you review, and what documents do you need?"_ You can also get assistance at a local DFR office. Visit [FSSA's work requirements page](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTh9AA0AAAAAAVAcyELI8bn747S7-DLic7FXSbyCmn2eV-SSXwG0auD1XbctDO89MWkfmUeAd9q-xx3qzKto1E2HjzEXjEjR47XUm7Rw3vVjt0y8 "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://www.in.gov/fssa/hip/hip-work-requirements/index__;!!FlTQaCg!gq2QrOH5c5rPKEE-1Xr1tlwL_ZM1uLB-ALSqQLyyzei6enMBGqPGa8g0Voad_tX_OXR6f4z0v-CvzjOcxUwbC5kqzuI$") for current guidance and the full exemption list. If you cannot understand a notice or get an answer, please contact my office promptly. If you receive a notice ending your coverage, check the appeal instructions and deadline right away. **You deserve help navigating these changes. Please begin preparing now, and share this information with anyone who may need it!**

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|--- | ---|--- | ---|--- | | Friends, In just a few short months, the General Assembly will begin working on the the 2027 budget. But the hundreds of pages and $46 billion that go along with it are only part of the story. Our budget is a moral document. It serves as a record of where our state's priorities were during that time and place. Which begs the immediate question, one that I have heard often, where do our state's priorities lie? Too often that answer seems to be steeped in agendas and culture wars that do more harm than good, My answer? Making the lives of the working families who call this state home more affordable and more dignified. This means access to high quality child care so that parents have the ability to stay in the workforce if they choose. It means Hoosier children and their grandparents both having access to healthcare. It means a single mother being able to put food on the table and keep the lights on. Unfortunately, this is too far from reality for too many folks in our state. But it doesn't have to be this way. With this budget, we can change that, adn you should be involved every step of the way. This is why the Indiana Senate Democrats started our statewide listening tour. To hear from you, and to inform the legislation that is drafted this upcoming session. Thank you to all of those who have showed up so far to make your voice heard. I am grateful to work alongside you in advocating for a state that our children can be proud of. In Service, State Senator Andrea Hunley Standing with Hoosier Workers BP locked out approximately 800 workers for more than six months. Now it 's challenging the unemployment benefits keeping their families afloat. This is corporate bullying. Hoosier families are not bargaining chips. I stand with USW Local 7-1. BP must withdraw its challenge and end the lockout. | | To everyone who has come out to our statewide listening sessions: thank you. ## Open AI Agents Hit over 100 Groups
OpenAI has [warned more than 100 organizations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAMB_CngS0oNiWUIcMtbL31RmSIAzkFUgW3qG9_Su8RvsWyZMn27__nMT0oxHCsv2lnKz5NB19nZBHO054y57S-mAKtfMgJe4gxpGNCjUaBVrqdaJHw5ulGtbOeGbmt2UI_gEYY8F5vdvZsqHM4LIQd6tkgzuT6wRP4zuulDrbsA61b0LrDvmkdzeANztwbvHNf3TS7ICk3f1M4ZGMfP-nNuVnSXke7iTzPqv1V4VjheF1X86EtpTKtcCygCsdXKZQlLJFLm558UFBfn6Kg_gsVec-LsFMAAGjgjs0me6yzdc-r6E9T3ll3CvF7Xn6Y2tvivwAAAP__kRiCOA) about incidents involving unauthorized activity by rogue AI agents, a sharp increase from the dozens the company acknowledged just a week ago. The ChatGPT maker is sifting through roughly [50 petabytes of data](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAMgJ8mbKkSw4V2yNCFrSfddCMyxEBOIUGJKerbn9JX-CcPtqzv-_6-xhf64OP6G3eyvKQx0lUCMVMe95Qpp_Uk9LhS5KJ3H4JPcQQFRmolVTvizP5NY4eNswsRUNuQ1f1DK9APuDebxc45JDSmfZChR9ffjZ5bnJdOzRMsrvG2_tNKtVqpX9DfWoeTXgxM1Bu4Uy86Rc5zyrd_yUfeaAmf9KZ8m9PeBLsxH0W0TwGDgOG6rtteYt0JGCjKswgYqpaAIfFGuc6DInqJgTIXWUUlbxilVkquOZ1HkTilk-XXX9bTWkB-bT1_BAyY5fMJLv6ZP0227rhqm2Iq7LqjD184_mHTt4X_AQAA___kTo3F) as it works to understand how far its models roamed. The review was triggered by the Hugging Face breach in July, when OpenAI agents escaped a testing sandbox and hacked the open-source AI platform's infrastructure. OpenAI called it the most severe rogue agent incident it has identified. Most cases uncovered so far have been low severity, with agents accessing [public government websites](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrDAMRb8mdEGJwwApUryGbl67JUrAgHdDMgIvaP9-lfmFlVxYutKxz_14jk9PkdL63-_oeMljwvuMyIzHuOcDj7x-oye_YuJT7xQj5TSCglZqJZUZ_cR04dj4anYLIqCp0OnOagXaQl9tbn6YBucep0ZbY7QFH2wHD93YPljVtxW5wtNKGa3UA7razD7opYWAXQs9dqJROBPno_7MlHjDJf7kC496ynsV3cb8OoX5J2AQMNz3XU_hLB4lFzCUVcCQX5g8yTLFRobM8q0nNz99ybUQ016SG8NJjAKG6nDz6y7WZ1veWHdP8X2W_9jW5eA3AAD___YNf-4) in unexpected ways, but the full review will take months and the final count could keep climbing.
## G7 Nations Agree to Release Diesel Fuel
The G7 nations agreed Friday to [release 100 million barrels](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAURE9jOpD9WWy2cJGGbtOmRAYP7I8MRrZ3UW4fkSukG2mkeXrz9RgfjgPv66fbYMsSxx1nDigFadxiQorrC47dir1ktXEIHPeRJOlayVq2o5sLvzHeXOXtAhDaClaZu5Kk7tRXT2sMusktutdmWmavb13vvewMDGTrSFdsrz0lZauk7Mg0rXeTWjRNMJp6GHGT8Fxiar4j7-WJJfzEN1Izx60K9lnKkUX7IWgQNJzn2cxTvjyuXtBwRUFDSa_tqPFK8UDtGRmhjhzqhACXIWiokvXHeTlmfUHXzXH4g5R_fvO29BsAAP__BXF6MA) of diesel fuel and crude oil from strategic reserves, beginning immediately and continuing over four months, with a substantial diesel drawdown within 20 days. The deal followed [days of pressure](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtutDAUhJ_GdEbHx7tcChd_Q7d_mxIZ-xgc-YKMF5K3j8grpB7pm5nv4zW_tA8-rf91JFVdnhNdR6BaqcwxFyp5fZP2eqVUDxF9CD6nGQE7LoCDnLWp_qT5oRurHBGSbEiJfhSAYsSh2RTZxS3GknbwxEEC9Jr6brRycG40T9N4dfMEgBQAT-xbafUiXIcL9R0O1LMHkPU1l_Yz-1Q3cuE7n1Rak2MT1FbrfjD5j-HEcLquqzVpMXfIcLrRDCcBDCdAhpP1dFDg2QdeyzvunN4l78Tpa8-l8kWndqsxNEXZ_br_Ht09YI3ah9_C-kdPp8KfAAAA__83lHz3) from President Trump, who had threatened to ban U.S. diesel exports. The agreement came together after an overnight call between Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron, who chairs the G7 this year. The G7 statement urged all producers to "refrain from imposing bans" on energy exports, in answer to the White House warning on holding back its diesel inventory.
## CNN Chief to Remain at New Skydance
The combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will be called [Skydance](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1ygzAQBeDTiA5mtRiwCxVp6Jw2JbNIK1CiH48km_HtM-QKqXfm2_fe1325k_Mubp8UWFWblshH8Vwr5yWkzDltTyZHG8daZHDeuxQXBBxbCS30C-nqXrxcqDHKMiP3DSs53SSgvOG12dWomQay02AuZCcyY28HWAmIBk1ouHHq9CRALwEGnLre0CrtiCtPI155Ehdg42rK3Xdyse5s_Tu9OHc6hcarvdZHEf2HwFngfBxHp-Oqz6PA-aQFzhIEzoAC5wdlCukZa3tQjpzbNafSGlf0Sb7b8vM2FDV3ew2-yco8jrN1Gc8YWyDn_97Wf671UvgbAAD__7KlgAA), CEO David Ellison announced Friday, naming the new media giant after the production company he founded two decades ago. Ellison is also setting the new company's news strategy. He has [asked CNN chief Mark Thompson](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAURp_GbEb2JYEweMjClq4d0cW-Brf-iWwHmrev6Ct0_qSj853Px_xA511cPzCQqjbNkY7iqVbKc0iZclpfhA5XirXI4Lx3Kc4goOdScNHNqKvbab5gY5QlAuoaUnIYpQA5wq3ZlO0E3nohRjlecemvFzMuepB60GSsHfvGqZMnheikEFcY2s7gIm0PCw093GhgF0HG1ZTbr-Ri3cj6d9optzqFxqut1mdh3Z3BxGA6jqMNJZ4bg4kifxUG03mLwZTqRpnBZHB3hpP3rqTIsXwXrmPkmhKviZeKb462UuZPzBjSK1Z-YI6UuSH0XPtU6ORh5vc7mPDzGJqszPM4A5X-NF4DOv9nWP8ZdlfwGwAA__9Sf4-B) to stay on after the merger. Thompson is seeking guarantees of editorial independence, and the deal's legal settlement requires an independent editorial board to arbitrate conflicts at CNN and CBS News. CBS News editor-in-chief Bari Weiss [won't have a role at CNN](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAURp8Gd4zgMuvxFBRp6DZtSutiLuOb5ccC4tG-feS8Qtrvk46Ozq_P9RM5cXn9xEx2xLoWevdEY1Bbc23U6usPIeOLyug6c0pcywoKZqmVVGbFbfBJ6x2nYCMRkJnI6sdTK9BPWKbdRlDBGLP5D63i4sNiwN_904eZ5mV-xontxdNKGa3UBzxuJqDXcQZPjxkWeoi7osCjttvvymXsFNN3PandtpqnZPcxji7MDwFOgCvfR-3jugS4CyzAaSXAKS3AZQqMApzHxvJN3LtsNZHEIbdSZKOTMFGQGAc1GfDkICkl7rXIjF_UZcb2Jcde83FtgTbuXIsANzUbjvdVqM-X8isjp3-K4z_Lnhb-BgAA__-AUI5c), despite earlier speculation she would oversee both newsrooms. The deal is set to close Oct. 6, with the stock moving to the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SKYD.

everything we built together.

attacking us.

Rogers' attack ads
* Knocking on doors in every corner of this state

volunteers

ballot

## LCRA Opens Floodgates as Rain Lingers
The Lower Colorado River Authority [opened floodgates](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwjAQheHTOB3ReOxAUrjYJh3bbhmN7QlYMhjZswncfgVX2PI1n57-n_NyppTT_fJNN3byXMty571lFuG6CD-pNcpUX3fm2PxvYG6NZUHA40HDAcxCQdLGi6UuOg9x0h07fZo04GBg7K7OjOPgbaCjHr2BSANovwY0HkaaEHWX3JvTAEZr0Nb2p8FEG2NEpgknE5QFjklK7eXKn1NrfpWNax_KrcvuKvJoynwpnBXO-773OVTqS728JwlXhfOaS4kK5666-NhTzqkdT8rC5UYpfyD5b4DN4V8AAAD__3omb_8) at Wirtz and Starcke dams on Friday, passing Llano River floodwaters downstream into Lake Travis. Flows below the dams will run higher and faster than usual, the agency said. Parts of the Hill Country have received [more than 7 inches](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOkf2AiEULv6GLn97JVrsJbHO2JF3A8nbn8g9wlVTfNLom_m6TlcMMaTbf1zJymvJU6KdI4lQmYReyIwRyzsReZ6fjoiZZAINZ2W00s2ETsJGU4u1t7P2g6nJmn4wGrpGX-q7vQBoPxM1CGC0u-juDDR3CJ1x3bD0dbBHndG6MUabtj31XeNb7z0QDjA0rmo1-SC5nOROH6klvvNG5eTyWkd7F3lw1fyrYKxgdDPjkyWkg1YwHoMqGGN2GI90BVV-UGLFguWblMdVLTFnf0MhhaxixJRVCRuVX7CjUFFr3oiVz3tiKYRrXax_7CHGwOe-avVtxRA_SvLXKzcLPwEAAP__14aM1Q) of rain since Wednesday. Lake Travis is forecast to rise 1 to 2 feet, while no floodgate operations are expected at the authority's other dams. A [flood watch](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL8GOqO1cQIULq6hy7VXosW7BEsGR3gDyd-fiO4PrpvRSKM383MbbhhiWO_fuLCT15SGlY8cWYS3QfiFOWPE7b0yUx6fnjlnlsGAuSoNCuoBvYSdB4sluRGo0yU73XQazKWGtpydN41n8L7lzrbjhFRfsaGxIzIWJsAyuLNOA9Rag7a2ai41WSIyjJ3pal9YYAqStkpm_kBN8Z123iqfljK6WeSRi_qrMH1h-jfOKZ1JYfpzTGH6g1Fm3tSfxU2Cj3zKGHZWzwehcFb4zBJWNcWUSB0oflba6hY6a3U1yxLLzdHjCDGGfG0KC_cFQ_xAyH_P2535DQAA__-NEYZi) covered the Austin metro through Friday evening, with isolated totals of 6 to 8 inches possible as the Austin City Limits Music Festival opened.

The 0-3 Houston Texans [host the Dallas Cowboys](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd1gwmNguKLZx97bd0sJmiNESEzHzwsvfr5xf2G40Vzo69_75Wr98yum8__YPdPwTy3pio4zMWFfGH0_ks6_vEzHQ9r0jEiGvoOAmtZLKrH7n9MJ18F1wmwqz7tDpcdYKrFFTdziE6QYY4wQbTLAbG2COs7WTBfAh2i65C6eVMlorPQz9aE0YQgiAfobZ7GJQGBKX2vOBH6mY3-WFtd_Lo8vuYH6SML8ELAKW1lp_bnuI7YoFLFcjAQs9S-Xr2PI3SmJfBSwX7SR5FGLJB8q9tK28SRLi33Ter1-qMqZKLFs6pY-MVXqppPkgWMAyqMlOoxWwdNWFZ0s5J7qNYlD3h0_5I8n_O-7Lwb8AAAD__8MpkC4) at noon Sunday, with just one win between the in-state rivals. It's the Cowboys' [first trip to Houston](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOgzAQRb8GOiO_wqNwsQ1dtt0SDXgIlhwceSY4_P0q0f7B9kfnXp2f63SFEMN--4Y7On6tadqxUERmzBPjC4ggQj53RE_zc0EkQp601K1QUkgzwcLhwMlC7d0s_aBqdKoblNQXI_t6c76zc2-MXXFuL-sie6Mt6k6ign6Zra2De-uUlEYpqaxtuovx1nuvEQY9mKWyEn3glBve8HNqjWc6MDdLutfRbcwPqsxXpcdKj6WUZk0v3W7pSZz2N1TpkR4pM1V69BAjkFhSmdNJ4o8Sb-9OIuOORYRdEAOjyOGAmM86O_8oIcZAbVdZebtDiJ91_m-1w-nfAAAA__8ieoWs) in eight years. Houston fell 19-17 at Indianapolis to start 0-3 for a second straight year, and coach DeMeco Ryans [took the blame](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OwyAUhE-DO1uPH4dQUGzjLttuaWF4CUjYRPDWiW-_cq6w5Uijb0bfz22-uZTT9vh2K1p638u84atlJMI6E75day67emyIoS2_HrE1pFmAuPQcepCz85R2nJXrgl0gGN6h5dpwEKOEaxftIrXWXgE3cNcgNb-AD8E4N2p5XTR0yZ44DiA5B67UoEcZVAhBoDPCSM8UYEhU6kARP6fu-Sg71sGXtcs2Ej0bk19MTExM7VkqteFwsZSzwMTkKiWfsTEx4Y71oJi2R3-SttZH3wdc0Ze-HmfmEuQoleFDpDV31YbnK-Wc2kUzBY_VpfzZpf_62q34CwAA__-RDIDA) for holding his timeouts on the Colts' winning drive. "_We're 0-3, obviously, I haven't coached well enough,"_ Ryans said.
## What It Really Costs To Get By in Texas
A single Texas adult needs $45,290 a year before taxes just to cover basic expenses, according to the [MIT Living Wage Calculator](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuOgzAURuHVmC7IL5K4cDENXaad0rrYP8SSgQjfQLL70WQLs4FPR-fnFm6US16mb5rh-TWuYcFRC5ixBcaLaqVC23sBUh2eEagVHLTU55OSJ2kCRc47gqUm-UEmpxp4dXFK6s7Ia3P3cRi7CMDFqKwdqHNWuThEGIlIGJvs_zglpVFKKmvbS2eSTSlpkNPORGElUuZ1a_mOT9RY3uuOrY3r3BR_Z35UYb6E7oXuS97zMh00oZ0zt0hPofvKxKhC9_babD49jlxKrueLsHKaKZePxP89sHv9GwAA__-PSnJU). Add one child, and that figure climbs to $74,391, or $35.77 an hour. [Child care costs](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAUhE9jOqPnnwQoXGxDl223RMZ-BGttHOEXCLdfwRW2Hmm--ebnMTxsiGF5ftuEhj5THhbcS0QiXAfCjy3FRrseC6Iv49shloI0SJB3LoCDGqyjsOGgbeXNCL4TFRrRdALkTUFbzQZs197abnJKNFopQKU9jhZaqXFs_VQFc9YJACUECK3r5qa89t5LtJ3slGMa0AfKa00zXqOmeOQN19rlVEUzE70KU19M9kz2-77Xv1TSGTLZnz5M9nPeeXq7mae84MF95kd-81OLU-YxbMhdTlNeyY7x4GHhF4jJvlqNf-0hxlDuDdPwTDbEi0z_fWwz8i8AAP__XFaCxg) run about $9,724 a year for one child and $19,178 for two. Housing for a single adult costs $14,679, with transportation adding thousands more. The single-adult living wage of $21.77 an hour is roughly three times the state's [$7.25 minimum wage](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFygzAQRU8DHcxKyBAKFWncOW1KZtEuWImEPNIa7Ntn7Cukfn_e_Hnfl-mCPvht_cLIVh5LmjY-SmARzpPwA0vBgPm5MVOZ7465FJZJg-4bBQ10EzrxO08Ga7Iz0KhqtmoYFehTBx_11fZDvxDNQz_ATIsx6LCneTk5zSO6kWpvXzoF0CkFyph2OHVkiEgzjnrsXGWAyUvKrVz5fWoJz7Rzbl2KdbBXkVupus9Knyt9lsO171G7pr3S5580F-ZfzuUFX6CJfvPxHpsDV24CHnW2dDt8CL70Q2VgjejDWy7_jbJb_RcAAP__XpF5yQ), which mirrors the federal rate.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: New AI Charter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261003-6794-footer&t=1001&akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU ]Pramila Jayapal

Hi Peter,

I just introduced new AI guardrails, and I wanted you to hear about it
here first.

As AI crosses more and more boundaries, the risks of using this
rapidly-advancing technology gets higher and higher. And it’s long past
time for public accountability.

But the Trump administration is currently being bankrolled and bribed by
AI and Big Tech companies — and we need all the resources we can get to
fight back and elect progressive leaders across the country to fight with
us.

Below, you’ll find my full email detailing how crucial this framework is,
and I hope you’ll take a moment to read it.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/51821?c0=pj-em-20261003-1.NwzcHQ&refcode=em20261003-6794&t=1002&akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU ]But first — can you chip in anything right now to help continue the
fight for progressive priorities like this bill, as well as Medicare for
All, just immigration reform, and an economy that works for working
people?

— Pramila

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Pramila Jayapal [info@pramilaforcongress.com]
Date: Thu, Oct 1, 2026
Subject: My bill on AI Safety ➡️
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]

Peter,

People keep asking: When is Congress finally going to do something about
AI? The conversation around the catastrophic risks of AI is getting louder
and louder – and we have been too slow to act.

I refuse to wait any longer. Today I’m releasing my framework for a
National AI Charter Act.

This framework is a comprehensive solution aimed at reigning in these
powerful AI companies.

A national charter forces companies to meet strict public interest,
safety, and spinoff requirements. In doing so, the charter breaks Big
Tech’s grip on AI and ensures dangerous AI models are not developed or
released.

We must act because the dangers of unchecked AI development are no longer
hypothetical. They’re showing up in people’s lives right now.

Recently, I heard from a mother who lost her son after receiving
dangerous, false medical information from a chatbot, instead of being
connected to a professional who could actually help him.

Her story is devastating, and preventable.

No one should lose their life because a greedy corporation decided to move
too fast and worry about the consequences later.

Workers across the country are being forced to train AI systems that will
replace their own jobs. Engineers and developers inside these companies
are sounding the alarm at how recklessly this technology is being
developed. And the American people are demanding action as data centers
encroach into our communities.

Workers whose livelihoods are being eliminated. Families who are grieving.
Communities whose water and energy are being drained to power data centers
they never asked for.

Peter, let me
be clear about what we’re up against: groups associated with OpenAI and
Anthropic have poured over $56 million into the midterms this cycle.

These corporations are not just developing AI too quickly with zero regard
for the human cost — they’re buying the politicians who are supposed to
regulate them. Working people need to be in the driver’s seat of this
technology. Not crushed underneath it.

Congress is facing a crossroads: treat the AI industry as too big to
question, or regulate it and require it to serve the public.

I choose the latter, every single time. This moment is urgent, and we must
meet it.

That’s why I’m proposing a National AI Charter that requires AI companies
to operate on the public’s terms or not at all. We need round-the-clock
government oversight to keep the public safe from risky AI. We need to
break Big Tech’s grip on AI. And we need serious criminal consequences for
the billionaires driving AI’s race to the bottom.

I’m going to fight for major regulations to hold AI companies accountable
and put real, enforceable safeguards in place before irreparable damage is
done. [ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261003-1.gvviKT&refcode=em20261003-6794&amount=3&t=1003&akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU ]If you’re able, will you please make a $3 contribution today to
help keep me in Congress fighting for AI safety?

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261003-1.gvviKT&amount=3&refcode=em20261003-6794&t=1022&akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Pramila Jayapal

Contribute to Pramila Jayapal: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20261003-6794-footer&t=1023&refcode2=6794_420207_pAsxfU&akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.pramilaforcongress.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=6794%2E420207%2EpAsxfU

body:
We’re fending off the GOP from all sides.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1573&source=&t=1&akid=4128%2E124072%2Ed2OQDD) | | | |

The MAGA machine is not holding back, Peter.
* President Trump personally attacked me when he rallied in North Carolina last month for my opponent, Michael Whatley, saying I’d make our state a "killing field."

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1573&amount=5&t=8&akid=4128%2E124072%2Ed2OQDD) |
* Then, Vice President JD Vance joined Whatley for another rally in Greensboro five days later to double down on the President’s baseless lies.

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1573&amount=5&t=9&akid=4128%2E124072%2Ed2OQDD) |
* Far-right super PACs – including one of Trump’s – are spending **nearly $100 million** so far to defeat me and keep this Senate seat red.

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1573&amount=5&t=10&akid=4128%2E124072%2Ed2OQDD) |
* Their attacks are working: Recent polls show this race is tightening.

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1573&amount=5&t=11&akid=4128%2E124072%2Ed2OQDD) | Now if we lose here in North Carolina, Democrats lose our shot at flipping the Senate.

CBS News' report (aired Sept. 10-11, 2026) centered on a surrogate given the pseudonym "Judy," who said she was blindsided to learn the intended father of the baby she is carrying was not a "single father" but Xu Bo, a Chinese billionaire and founder of video game company Duoyi Network. Leaked documents obtained by CBS named him as the intended parent. CBS says Xu has been reported to have more than 100 children born through U.S. surrogates; a former romantic partner suing him over custody claims the figure could be as high as 300. Xu disputes both numbers and says he has custody of 12 U.S.-born children.
**What 's corroborated elsewhere**
The Wall Street Journal reported the broader pattern earlier: clerks in a Los Angeles family court (Judge Amy Pellman's office) noticed the same father's name appearing repeatedly in surrogacy petitions, triggering the custody case. Accounts linked to Xu on Weibo allegedly spoke of wanting "50 high-quality sons," and he reportedly said "having more children can solve all problems." In a 2023 hearing he reportedly said he hoped for around 20 U.S.-born children to one day run his business. The motive is straightforward: all forms of surrogacy are banned in China, while a child born on U.S. soil is a U.S. citizen under the Fourteenth Amendment -- no matter the parents' nationality...

| Friend,
---
| If you live in Michigan or North Carolina right now, you’re going through _hell_.
---
| Everytime you turn on the TV, _it’s political ad after political ad_ , all fighting over the two marquee Senate races. In those two states alone, spending is projected to reach _over $1 billion_.
---
| But while voters in MI and NC are being drowned by those senate ads, something just as important is happening quietly on the same ballot—state Supreme Court races.
---
| These courts decide whether your vote actually counts. They protect voting rights. They stop gerrymandered maps. They protect abortion rights. And this year, both North Carolina and Michigan have seats on the line.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Ju4h7OWzugb6PndDH1bHxNSE8VPDTxZlQBeBtwnX_DgzhmMFrQ6y21_ZxVxHs4msJxfX32kBhD-4gNNJDqrsA-bBuxuR881OmzQ6HlUmmbm4bTOWPdmfkg8fjZ8iEOQ8wROeV0kdvRte_2R-4wmbvIbzJ5LTyJZzIlnsnN5kv82DxFKTHPU5yEevqrXBgHaaKnMHNERZ9mN7YoOdPreFqkztn3OXxHRvmM0nCzYecrk23YuLU3NIoMuuXggUtr48awWvWgbFSHXWNrUPRRqxGw==&c=Js0cwmLshrP6Z0djR287xIdYz2if8hU69A0UUoamTziY7lAWj10MRw==&ch=CzykMeiX_zWahdvJLzTIgpw6lAr5aHW7nQAo9f9tZ27r1Mb5ndBDbw==)

## **The Metanoia Project Needs Our Help**
The most important thing I wrote about was the Metanoia Project.
Metanoia has operated a seasonal winter shelter in Cleveland for approximately 20 years. It runs on a small budget but produces big results for people who might not use the traditional shelter system.
I volunteered there in 2019. I worked the showers, handed out towels, socks, underwear, and toiletries, and talked to people who used Metanoia as a springboard back into employment and stable housing.
Now the organization is struggling to raise enough money to open this winter.
This is the kind of project that communities should be supporting: a small budget, limited political theater, and real results. Please read the article, share it, and consider whether you know anyone who can help keep Metanoia open.
The Angry Ohioan

## **My Cuyahoga County Ballot-Issue Recommendations**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6dbfd622-62ab-45e2-b3ac-5764f5fa6be7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Cuyahoga County Democratic Party released its endorsements for Issues 3 and 10 through 14.
I wanted to offer my own recommendations and explain my reasoning because simply telling voters to vote yes or no is not enough.
* * *
### **Issue 3: Voter Identification**
**My recommendation: NO**
Ohio already requires photo identification for in-person voting. Issue 3 would place that requirement into the Ohio Constitution, making it more difficult for the state to adapt if better, more secure, or more accessible identification technology becomes available.
The Angry Ohioan
[Issue 3: Ohio Already Requires Photo ID, So Why Put It in the Constitution?](https://substack.com/redirect/3a26bfd6-85ca-48b6-8972-f7f118c587eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hey, Angry Ohioans...

15 days ago * 1 like * The Angry Democrat
* * *
### **Issue 10: Developmental Disabilities Levy**
**My recommendation: NO**
Issue 10 would add a new 2.25-mill property-tax levy for 10 years while **the existing 3.9-mill continuing levy remains in place**. I support services for people with developmental disabilities, but I do not believe county leaders have demonstrated enough fiscal responsibility or sufficiently explained why taxpayers should provide another approximately $99.7 million every year.
The Angry Ohioan
[Issue 10: What the New 2.25-Mill Levy Would Cost Cuyahoga County Homeowners](https://substack.com/redirect/5ea8d19c-d7bb-4c54-9433-585fa9c6351a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hey, fellow Angry Ohioans...

14 days ago * 1 like * 5 comments * The Angry Democrat
* * *
### **Issue 11: Health and Human Services Levy**
**My recommendation: NO**
Issue 11 combines two separate questions into one vote: whether to renew the existing 4.7-mill levy and whether to add another 2.5 mills. The existing levy remains authorized through 2028, and the proposed increase would raise substantially more than a reasonable adjustment for inflation.
Voters should be able to decide whether to continue the existing funding separately from whether the county needs another approximately $110.76 million annually. Combining those questions into one proposal is dishonest.
The Angry Ohioan
[My Objection to Issue 11: With HB920 Included](https://substack.com/redirect/5317e4c3-7551-4ae9-a9eb-0c624264191d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

13 days ago * 3 likes * 1 comment * The Angry Democrat
* * *
### **Issue 12: Council Confirmation of Board Removals**
**My recommendation: YES, with a caveat**
Issue 12 would require County Council to confirm certain removals of board and commission members initiated by the County Executive. I support adding that check on executive power, but I also believe Council should have an appropriate mechanism for initiating removal proceedings instead of merely reacting when the executive decides to remove someone.
The Angry Ohioan

11 days ago * 1 like * 1 comment * The Angry Democrat
* * *
### **Issue 13: Division Between the Law Director and Prosecutor**
**My recommendation: NO**
Issue 13 would divide legal responsibilities between the independently elected County Prosecutor and a Law Director who serves at the pleasure of the County Executive. I would rather have contracts, negotiations, legal advice, litigation, discovery, and institutional knowledge housed within one legal department under the elected Prosecutor, with Council receiving legal advice that is institutionally independent from the executive.

10 days ago * 2 likes * 2 comments * The Angry Democrat

### **Issue 14: Charter Review Commission Appointments**
**My recommendation: YES, with caveats**
Issue 14 would divide appointments to the Charter Review Commission between the County Executive and County Council instead of allowing every nomination to originate with the executive. I support distributing appointment power, but Council's appointments are not guaranteed to provide minority-party, ideological, or geographic representation, and eight of the nine appointees would no longer receive cross-branch review.

## **Ohio 's 90-Day Gas-Tax Holiday**
Ohio's 90-day gas-tax holiday passed the General Assembly, and the entire thing was a convoluted political mess.
Amy Acton proposed a gas-tax holiday. Vivek Ramaswamy later supported the idea, Republicans called a special session, Democrats attacked the bill as a political stunt, and then several Democrats voted for it anyway.
Meanwhile, the state is creating a roughly $725 million hole without clearly explaining where the replacement money will come from.
People will save money at the pump, and some families will genuinely feel that relief. But the politics made no sense, the Democratic positioning was all over the place, and the bill created more questions than answers.
The Angry Ohioan

## **Cuyahoga County Council District 5**
The District 5 race between Mike Gallagher and Courtney Scheff came down to fiscal responsibility.
Gallagher made county spending, the jail, reserves, taxes, and executive overreach the center of his campaign. Scheff talked about responsible oversight but continued supporting many of the same services, programs, and priorities promoted by County Executive Chris Ronayne.
At a time when the county is approaching more than $1 billion in justice-system construction commitments and asking residents for additional taxes, Gallagher's warning was the one I believed County Council most needed to hear.
The Angry Ohioan

I like to write about vinyl -- what records cost, what it takes to get one from a shop in Melbourne or Rotterdam to my door, and how rules written somewhere else quietly decide what I'm allowed to buy and what it costs me to get it here. This week I'm straying from my beat, because an essay crossed my desk that asks a much bigger version of the question I chase in my own work: who decides what reaches you, and what happens when the people setting those rules all seem to answer to each other?
The essay, published at Malone News, starts with Netflix and ends somewhere considerably larger: a post-presidential architecture spanning entertainment, politics, academia, government, and now artificial intelligence. Here is my summary, followed by my own read.

Today, we are officially one month out from November 3rd.

It's crunch time, and we're falling behind.

Peter,
A devastating collapse could be coming for Democrats in Michigan this November.

No, not in the U.S. Senate race. In a race far fewer people are paying attention to: the Michigan Supreme Court.

Two pro-democracy justices, Megan Cavanagh and Noah Hood, are up for reelection. Both are facing competitive races against MAGA-backed challengers.
State Supreme Courts are crucial for protecting democracy. When MAGA tries to toss out ballots, these courts stop them. When politicians draw rigged maps, these courts throw them out. When extremists come for abortion rights, these courts are the last line of defense.
---
---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H03ky-cpXonhz5fQ_OLkxHiEuPXkzlb0JkjkSKTjfVhJycnvHBSWF9GiK3i1Cx-VK14Hxmkhly2Pwb9UaX2lp4fJFbT5TuA_LfRal3fVtsvpf3RAAXNa7cN85-e7D_HEB5kvw8WF6RL2-egyWqbcgQyXu9h08clDkRmwiiKw8yABpfqUVTH254sElUiG0wfZm-IQMS9_ljrC8cQEtlM-HOYeHmbEsePFWu1mwRk2Sio=&c=e18RqWarAf1o7VEVeZY2s22srE6CYkvJl1-Qn1i9JWopj6tuOh24Ug==&ch=CcQhYsgr1VtMF2iJlB1gNZiAvJewGVV8IXawjqE6X1IDLpL9CUG88A==)

In a swing state like Michigan, those decisions affect the entire country, from control of the House to the 2028 presidential election.
Here is the problem: these races are nonpartisan. There will be no party affiliation listed next to Cavanagh's or Hood's names on the ballot.
We are expecting unprecedented turnout this midterm. That means a flood of first-time and infrequent voters, people who do not follow politics as closely as we do. If we do not tell them who the pro-democracy justices are, they could inadvertently vote for MAGA's candidates.
Like a mad scientist in a disaster movie, Defend Our Courts is warning anyone who will listen about this potential catastrophe. But we aren't just talking, we are mobilizing to contact voters across Michigan and get the word out before it is too late.
In 2025, we led the way in Pennsylvania's Supreme Court race. With the help of over 100,000 Democrats nationwide, Pennsylvania's liberal justices kept their majority by landslide margins. We did it again in Wisconsin earlier this year and helped deliver another blowout.

Both are facing competitive races against MAGA-backed challengers. State Supreme Courts are crucial for protecting democracy. When MAGA tries to toss out ballots, these courts stop them. When politicians draw rigged maps, these courts throw them out. When extremists come for abortion rights, these courts are the last line of defense. | | == In a swing state like Michigan, those decisions affect the entire country, from control of the House to the 2028 presidential election. Here is the problem: these races are nonpartisan. There will be no party affiliation listed next to Cavanagh's or Hood's names on the ballot. We are expecting unprecedented turnout this midterm. If we do not tell them who the pro-democracy justices are, they could inadvertently vote for MAGA's candidates. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Biggest school choice reform in America’s history – what it means for Mississippi
body:
Biggest school choice reform in America’s history – what it means for Mississippi | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msgala2026-12855017?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
This week, Washington published the rulebook for the biggest school choice reform in American history. On Thursday, the Treasury and the IRS released the regulations for the new federal scholarship tax credit. Congress created it in the One Big Beautiful Bill last summer. Since then, states, charities and taxpayers have been waiting for the detail. Now they have it. The credit goes live on January 1st. For most of the last century, the money for a child's schooling has followed the system, not the child. Where you lived decided where your child went to school, unless you could afford to pay twice: once in taxes and again in tuition. This is different. For the first time, the federal tax code lets ordinary taxpayers decide where a slice of their taxes goes, and it lets them send it to a child's education. How does it work? From January, you can give up to $1,700 to a Scholarship Granting Organization, or SGO. A married couple can give $3,400. Every dollar comes straight back off your federal tax bill. It is not a deduction—it is a credit, dollar for dollar. So for most people, it costs nothing. The only question is who gets the money: the IRS, or a child. The SGO pools what it receives and awards scholarships. Families earning up to 300 percent of area median income qualify. Treasury reckons that covers 96 percent of children in participating states. The scholarships pay for tuition, tutoring, books and special needs support. The money goes to the school. It never goes to a family as cash. You cannot earmark your gift for a particular child, and that includes your own. The rules are strict, as they should be. At least 90 percent of what an SGO takes in must go out in scholarships. Every SGO is audited every year. Treasury expects that by 2030, more than 11 million Americans will be giving. That would be nearly $26 billion a year, funding up to 2.2 million scholarships. What does this mean for Mississippi? The credit only applies in states whose governor opts in. Thirty have now done so. Mississippi was one of the first: Governor Reeves opted us in back in January. What happens next matters. The Governor's office must decide which charities qualify as SGOs and send that list to the IRS by February 15th. Only organizations on that list can receive gifts that earn the credit. That means that within a few months, Mississippians will have decisions to make. Which SGOs should you trust with your $1,700? Who do they serve? If you are a parent, where do you apply? Until now, there has been no single place to find out. So we built one.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/jx4kGCovYy1?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
_Click on the image above to learn more:_
| Go to [CompareMySchool.com/sgos](https://us.list-manage.com/uB08IaAQ21b?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3). It is Mississippi's one-stop shop for the federal scholarship tax credit. It explains, in plain English, how the credit works, who qualifies, and the dates that matter. You can download a one-page fact sheet. When the Governor names the state's SGOs, every one of them will be listed there, along with our own guide to what each does and who it helps. Sign up on the site, and we will tell you the day the list goes live. For years, school choice has been something politicians argued about. From January, it becomes something you can do yourself, with money you were going to hand to the IRS anyway.
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

Who do they serve? If you are a parent, where do you apply? Until now, there has been no single place to find out. So we built one. | Click on the image above to learn more: | Go to . It is Mississippi's one-stop shop for the federal scholarship tax credit. It explains, in plain English, how the credit works, who qualifies, and the dates that matter. You can download a one-page fact sheet. When the Governor names the state's SGOs, every one of them will be listed there, along with our own guide to what each does and who it helps. Sign up on the site, and we will tell you the day the list goes live. For years, school choice has been something politicians argued about. From January, it becomes something you can do yourself, with money you were going to hand to the IRS anyway. | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO Mississippi Center for Public Policy | | |

While my Republican opponent, Michael Whatley, is relying on megadonors and dark-money super PACs to fuel and shape the direction of his campaign, I’m depending on people like you. I want to know _your_ interests, concerns and hopes for the future. That is what our grassroots movement is all about.
President Trump and the GOP are going all in to defeat me because they know that if we lose here, Democrats can say goodbye to our chances of taking back the U.S. Senate majority.
**That means this is the most important Senate race in the country, and the only way I can fight back against the GOP’s attacks and win is with an airtight campaign strategy.[_I need to hear from you directly, Peter. | | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Friend, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Friend, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time.
