Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Friend, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Friend, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: The cavalry
body:
More Texans support me than believe I can win.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
In just a minute, I’m going to personally ask you to **[make a $5 donation to my campaign for governor.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261003_1_save.2ZnMRA&refcode=em20261003-2317&amount=5&t=1&akid=2317%2E299639%2EyjzSbO)**
Before I do, there's something I need supporters outside of Texas to understand.
A new Marist poll has me ahead of Greg Abbott, 49% to 46%. _But only 28% of Texans think I'll actually win._
I think I know why. **Texans have learned to expect that we'll be left to fight Abbott's machine alone, and as long as they believe that, they won't believe we can win.**

clean_body: Friend, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. body:
She's fighting for the right things

---
| | | | Hey Peter, it's Mark Kelly.
---
I'm writing today on behalf of my friend and colleague, Laura Gillen.
In 2024, she flipped this seat blue by just 2 points. Republicans have been coming after her ever since.
Both Trump and Speaker Mike Johnson have personally campaigned against her. National Republican money is flooding into her district because they know exactly what's at stake if they can take this seat back.
I know what it's like to have that kind of pressure bearing down on you. I've had the full weight of this administration come after me directly. What I've learned is that the people who fight the hardest are usually the ones who get targeted the most, and that's exactly who Laura is.
This seat is one of a handful that decides whether Democrats take back the House majority. If we hold it, we get real oversight of this administration. If we lose it, Republicans keep governing without a check on their power.
[**_I'm asking you to help Laura the same way so many of you helped me when I needed it most. Fighting to Save the Academy of Natural Sciences - Join Me!| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140565786/650907307/-1991619688?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNkYjc5NmUtMzNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c6bDF9WPfeVJHnV_DHeKju9A5GKB45jYAAUAyuzWefs=)

| | | Hi Friend , Like so many of you that I have heard from over the last few weeks, _I was shocked to learn of the planned closure of Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum_. This jewel of science and culture in the heart of Philadelphia is a two-hundred year old facility and a beacon of education and love of sciences that we must do everything in our power to ensure it's presence for future generations of budding scientists. **As a scientist and Philadelphia City Councilmember, I believe deeply in the importance of science education, public access to scientific knowledge, and institutions that inspire young people to ask questions and explore the world around them**. The Academy has played that role in Philadelphia for nearly two centuries and I plan to do everything in my power to [ensure it continues to play that role moving forward](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140565787/650907308/382477416?nvep=&hmac=&emci=6994ba8a-bcbd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNkYjc5NmUtMzNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c6bDF9WPfeVJHnV_DHeKju9A5GKB45jYAAUAyuzWefs=). [I passed legislation in City Council last week](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140565788/650907318/-2088358018?nvep=&hmac=&emci=6994ba8a-bcbd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNkYjc5NmUtMzNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c6bDF9WPfeVJHnV_DHeKju9A5GKB45jYAAUAyuzWefs=) to demand greater transparency about the decision to close the museum and to examine what alternatives remain. City Council has authorized hearings through the Committee on Legislative Oversight, including the ability to subpoena testimony, to investigate the closure and explore options for preserving public access and the Academy’s scientific and educational mission. You may have also heard that [there are also potential avenues that deserve serious examination](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140565789/650907337/1131562219?stkn=MWhrdjA3amZpcXM3bQ%3D%3D&nvep=&hmac=&emci=6994ba8a-bcbd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNkYjc5NmUtMzNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c6bDF9WPfeVJHnV_DHeKju9A5GKB45jYAAUAyuzWefs=)—from philanthropic support and partnerships to financing options and other arrangements that could preserve public access. A recent funding offer from the William Penn Foundation has added another important dimension to the conversation.**Our hearing is scheduled for October 7 at 2 p.m. at City Hall.** I encourage you to watch or attend as I will continue working to understand how we arrived at this point and what can be done to preserve this Philadelphia institution and its public mission. **[Click HERE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140565790/650907365/1864608219?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWNkYjc5NmUtMzNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c6bDF9WPfeVJHnV_DHeKju9A5GKB45jYAAUAyuzWefs=&emci=6994ba8a-bcbd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=acdb796e-33bf-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=2348252) for more coverage:**

body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9293%2E582294%2EbwUHpU ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9293%2E582294%2EbwUHpU ]Chris Pappas for Senate

There’s just ONE MONTH left until Election Day.

That’s all: Just 31 days until the polls close, and we know who will be
New Hampshire’s next Senator. What we do with that time matters.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261003_1.wrMHMQ&refcode=em20261003-1&t=1003&akid=9293%2E582294%2EbwUHpU ]Please make a $5 contribution today to help our
grassroots operation keep going through this final stretch.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261003_1.wrMHMQ&amount=5&refcode=em20261003-1&t=1004&akid=9293%2E582294%2EbwUHpU ]Donate $5 »

If you’ve been following New Hampshire politics, you know a lot can change
in a month.

Voters are paying more attention. We’re making our final case. There’s
plenty left to do before November 3rd.

John Sununu and his Republican allies are spending millions of dollars in
New Hampshire. Outside groups are flooding the state with ads attacking me
and trying to define this race — to the tune of $50 million.

We can’t outspend them, but we can outwork them.

Over these final 31 days, we’ll be traveling all over New Hampshire to
show Granite Staters what we’re made of. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261003_1.wrMHMQ&refcode=em20261003-1&t=1005&akid=9293%2E582294%2EbwUHpU ]We can’t do it without your
help.
Please make a contribution of $5 or any amount today.

This election is about more than how much money is spent — it’s about what
New Hampshire needs.

Donald Trump endorsed John Sununu, and Sununu has said that winning this
seat is key to advancing Trump’s agenda.

I’m running to put New Hampshire first.

I’m running to make life more affordable for working families and to
protect the freedoms and benefits that Granite Staters expect and deserve.

It’s what I’ve done in Congress, and it’s what I’ll keep doing in the
Senate.

But we only have 31 days.

The final month will be busy. We’re knocking doors, making calls, talking
to voters, and ensuring that people across the state hear directly from
us.

There’s no substitute for that work, and we’re running out of time.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Bailey wanted to be sure you knew he was grateful too
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Nothing but gratitude in this email

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3044%2E4032634%2EaNtHt5)
---
Here's something I've learned in my career: You don't build lasting change with one big speech, one big check, or one big election. You build it with people who keep showing up day after day, even when the fight is hard, because they believe that better is possible. You build it with people like you. And I get to see it every day. I see it in the volunteers who knock on doors and make phone calls. The people who share our work with their friends and family. The supporters who chip in $3, $30, or $300 when they can. The people who have been with us since our very first Senate race in 2012, and the people who just recently got in the fight. There are a million different ways to show up. And every one of them matters. The way you show up matters. I know it isn't always easy. Our opponents want you to believe that nothing can change. They want you to get cynical. They want you to get tired. They want you to look at the size of the challenges in front of us and decide there's no point in trying. But you keep showing up anyway. With rugged determination and clear-eyed optimism. Belief that we can change the status quo. And that's what gives me hope. With the midterms just weeks away, we're going to need every bit of that determination. I’m asking you to commit to doing what you can, when you can. Knock on doors, make calls, text your group chats about their plans to vote, share content on social media, chip in to campaigns you’re passionate about. Because we not only have determination, we have a vision: A government that actually looks out for its people instead of corporations. An economy that gives everyone a fair chance. Ending the corruption and the billionaire influence that has plagued our politics. This is all within our reach. And we will get it done because people like you refuse to stop showing up. So this email doesn't have an ask in it. No donate button. No deadline. Just this: Thank you. I'm deeply grateful for you. I'm honored to be fighting this righteous fight with you. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth P.S. Bailey wanted to be sure you knew he was grateful too.

---

| This is a longer message about my faith.

Derek, When I was 13, in a bow tie and braces, at my Bar Mitzvah, I had no idea what the next fifty years would ask of me. Here's the photo of me, in all my "glory" back then: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=10&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_100326_faith&akid=10658%2E5257348%2EdaWdPu) It's easy to chuckle at it now — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the look on my face — but I think about that kid a lot these days. The values I learned preparing for that morning are the same ones I lean on now: that we're commanded to pursue justice, that we don't turn away from a stranger, that silence in the face of wrong is its own kind of failure. Throughout my career in public service, I've thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of "Tikkun Olam" — repairing the world. Lately, I keep coming back to how much harder it's become to live those values out loud: watching hate rise, watching people target Jewish institutions, watching leaders who should know better stay quiet about antisemitism. I won't stay quiet. **[Before I go any further — will you chip in a few dollars to support this work? If you're not ready yet, please read on. I have more to share.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=12&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_100326_faith&akid=10658%2E5257348%2EdaWdPu)** | | [PITCH IN→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=13&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_100326_faith&akid=10658%2E5257348%2EdaWdPu)
---
I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the "schmata" business. He worked as a regional manager for a men's clothing company, named Farrah.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There's nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah:_What is required of us, but to do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God._**
These principles have guided my work in Congress and now in the Senate — pursuing justice, making housing the homeless a priority, fighting discrimination, and making sure the rule of law applies to everyone. They have also guided me as I stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me now, in the fight to repair and rebuild our democracy — so we leave it better for my children, and yours.
That's why I put everything I have into my work in the Senate and for the cause of our democracy. It's the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don't rest until I've done all I can for the day.

**Donald Trump just gave my MAGA opponent his “Complete and Total Endorsement” in a video posted to social media this morning:**

Donald Trump just gave my MAGA opponent his “Complete and Total Endorsement” in a video posted to social media this morning: | | Here’s why this matters: Donald Trump had already endorsed Greg Cunningham before today. That’s why my team has set an emergency 24-hour fundraising goal to prepare for the onslaught of attack ads and outside interests that are about to flood our district. This is the same Donald Trump who keeps posting maps that cross out "Mexico" and rename our state "New America." He even calls it that in this video. body:
Get the training, coaching, and community to lead a campaign on your campus. | | | Peter, Every big win for students started with them organizing and refusing to back down. In-state tuition is one of those wins. It means students who grew up in a state, including undocumented students, pay the same tuition as their classmates instead of much higher out-of-state rates. DACA is another.win by Immigrant young people. DACA gave us the ability to work, study, and build a future in the country we call home. Now those wins are under attack. The federal government has sued all 21 states that offer in-state tuition, trying to take away the policies that opened the door to college for so many immigrant students. And it’s happening while many of us are already stretched thin, working multiple jobs just to afford classes while student debt climbs. Moments like this are when we need to step up. clean_body: | | | | | Peter , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me. I thought so too, until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the next few days. Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Rather than covering for a team on the ground, the fate of more than 10 million people will be decided in November. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming End-of-Month fundraising deadline. This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I’m not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I’m asking is a $1 or more donation, which will go right into my campaign's war chest and help me and President Trump take down the Democrat machine come November. As a combat veteran and a patriot - I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I’m eternally thankful for ANY gift you can make. Time is running out. Kelly Ayotte has already spent more than **$2 million on attack ads** against me.

name: Shelly Arnoldi
subject: A grassroots campaign for real change in Northern Virginia
body:
Please watch, share, and help us keep building momentum with yard signs, donations, and community support
| | | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear friends and neighbors,
I wanted to send a quick update and ask for your help.
Please watch and share the [1-hour televised candidate panel](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ODxwW5iKKlcOviiUdP-jmZJKnL_UXCz69DOL2Okz0z1EbuPgMUYA_k9PwDj2M2yh1jtHetLnbFuS1q0ypRyfEidw9DiJ3GdbMV2THdjOYNXOj_tmPkfLfDd_PJkWzi4uZcCZeiNFPXjCJeR4e3lDu75-6UqljLP7&c=dXI6B1KjOic9vPIuDOIBZVQOrIxa4-l4W9shtSV-gb_QJVr3emAR8g==&ch=CM5dy2aujPW8-WzjIE0JwB91RqPTeRL8xHzRd5Vo-rorxbngh-vUcA==) hosted by the League of Women Voters. It's a wonderful chance to hear directly from the candidates and share it with friends and neighbors who care about the future of Northern Virginia.
I'm running as a grassroots mom, without the backing of major party money, and that's what makes this campaign so meaningful. It shows that ordinary families can step up, speak out, and be a real voice for change when people are ready for something better.
Northern Virginia needs fresh energy, stronger accountability, and leaders who truly put families first. That starts with everyday people getting involved, staying informed, and helping build a movement big enough to fix what's broken.
If you'd like to help, you can put a sign in your yard or donate to my campaign so I can purchase more signs. Every campaign staff member is a volunteer, and I'm proud to show that real change is possible without big fundraising events or paid media ads.
Please reach out to me directly if you want to join the team.
With gratitude & optimism,
---
Shelly Arnoldi Candidate for Virginia's 8th Congressional District shellyarnoldi4va.org 202-285-7474

I know when folks chip in to our campaign, they're choosing to not give their hard-earned money somewhere else. I don't take that lightly.
If - and only if - you can, I'm asking you to make a crucial donation today to help us flip North Carolina and the Senate. I won't be able to stay competitive in this race without your grassroots support.
We're building something special here in North Carolina, and we're doing it the right way: with the support of people like you, chipping in $5 or $10 at a time.
In fact, more than 90% of our donations come from folks giving $100 or less.
We have our work cut out for us, though. Republicans are seeing our campaign grow by the day, they're reading the headlines and they know we have what it takes to flip this seat.
We'll be drowned out if we don't have the resources to fight back. Unlike my MAGA opponent - former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley -- I'm not relying on massive checks from billionaires and special interests to coast to victory. I'm counting on grassroots folks like you.
[Please, will you chip in $5 to make sure we have the resources to defeat President Trump's guy, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/e5335ad9-c271-4f0e-ac65-8aac6772fa38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

How much you give isn't important. What means the most to me is that you're choosing to give in the first place. Thank you so much.
Roy Cooper

clean_body: Folks, I know when folks chip in to our campaign, they're choosing to not give their hard-earned money somewhere else. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | | Oct 3 | | | | | | | | | | | | I know when folks chip in to our campaign, they're choosing to not give their hard-earned money somewhere else. I don't take that lightly. If - and only if - you can, I'm asking you to make a crucial donation today to help us flip North Carolina and the Senate. I won't be able to stay competitive in this race without your grassroots support. We're building something special here in North Carolina, and we're doing it the right way: with the support of people like you, chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. In fact, more than 90% of our donations come from folks giving $100 or less. We have our work cut out for us, though. Republicans are seeing our campaign grow by the day, they're reading the headlines and they know we have what it takes to flip this seat. We'll be drowned out if we don't have the resources to fight back. Unlike my MAGA opponent - former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley -- I'm not relying on massive checks from billionaires and special interests to coast to victory. I'm counting on grassroots folks like you. How much you give isn't important. What means the most to me is that you're choosing to give in the first place. Thank you so much. Parents, nurses, teachers, and veterans decided they were done being told South Carolina could never change. Nobody handed us this race. We built it together. (My opponent can’t say the same 😂). Now, it all comes down to the next month. Over these final weeks, every dollar decides how many doors we knock, how many voters see our ads, and whether we have what it takes to get every last supporter to the polls. Republicans have Donald Trump, corporate PACs, and billionaire megadonors on their side. We have you. A lot about this race has changed since I jumped in. My mission hasn't. [ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, people
often write to me, and what surprises me the most is who they are.

It's almost never someone who already agrees with me on every single
issue. A lot of the time, it's someone who wouldn't call themselves a
Democrat, who probably didn't vote for me last time, and who noticed
something their government did and wanted to say so.

I keep many of those letters — because those folks are the whole thing.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/14985?t=1001&akid=518%2E245147%2ETq4pLK ]They're also the folks who this election comes down to — and the only
way we reach more of them is by traveling across every corner of the
Commonwealth and knocking on their doors — which takes serious resources.
So I'm asking directly: Will you donate as much as you can right now and
support our campaign through the final stretch?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/14985?t=1002&akid=518%2E245147%2ETq4pLK ]Donate →

Here's what the past four years have taught me,
Derek.

The voters who decide elections in Pennsylvania aren't at our rallies.
They're people who are worn out by politics and have mostly stopped tuning
in — until something lands close enough to home that they can't help but
notice.

Their kid eats breakfast for free at school now. They qualified for a
brand new tax credit to lower childcare costs. The road they take to work
finally got fixed.

None of that comes with a name attached. But somebody has to go tell them.

That somebody? They’re an organizer at a door in a county most campaigns
write off — which is the part that takes real resources, and the part
we've got only a month left to do.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/14985?t=1003&akid=518%2E245147%2ETq4pLK ]So please,
Derek: If the progress we've
built here over the last four years is worth protecting to you, chip in
any amount today — because the people who haven't heard about it yet are
the ones who decide whether it lasts.

This one gets into the latest developments surrounding Andrew and Tristan Tate and the ongoing effort to extradite them to the United Kingdom. We break down the newly scheduled court proceedings, the Tate brothers' legal team's public response, and why their fight over extradition continues to matter.
* [**00:01:28**] A federal judge takes the next step toward a final extradition hearing--and the Tate brothers' attorney responds publicly.
* [**00:03:04**] Myron Gaines is named as a witness in a related case, raising new questions about the broader influencer circle surrounding the Tates.
* [**00:05:00**] We unpack Gaines' appeal to Barron Trump and his argument that the Trump administration should intervene.
* [**00:07:32**] The episode turns to the allegations against the Tates, the extradition treaty with the UK, and why the legal process has become such a major battleground.
* [**00:10:24**] Andrew Tate responds publicly as we look at what could become public if the extradition proceedings advance.

There are a lot of accusations, legal arguments, and political relationships tangled together here. This episode walks through what's being said publicly, what the transcript describes as the latest movement in the extradition process, and the arguments being made by the Tates and their defenders as the legal proceedings continue. name: Troy Downing
subject: “These things we do, that others may live.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
September 11th changed my life forever.

| Peter,
How many members of Congress do you know who can fly nearly every type of aircraft, have developed a successful tech startup and enlisted in the Air Force at 34 years old?
My name is Troy Downing – can you give me just a couple of minutes of your time to share my story? I promise you, it's not going to be one you'll forget.
In my youth, I helped develop graphics technology at an NYU lab that won an Academy Award and built a successful startup that merged with Yahoo!
And in 2001, I had a beautiful life. I went from a dirt-poor childhood to having a beautiful wife, a home, and four kids of my own.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
Then came September 11th.
Like millions of Americans, I watched the horror of that day unfold. But as a 34-year-old businessman, I couldn't just sit back and watch others fight for our freedom.
I knew I had to give back to the country that gave me everything.
I walked right into a military recruitment office, looked the recruiter in the eye, and said, "Hey, I have a commercial pilot's license, I used to teach math at NYU – what can you do with me?"
I signed on the dotted line, went to boot camp, and proudly joined a U.S. Air Force Combat Search and Rescue squadron.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-W0kM2PNvO9WDw)
---
I served eight years and did two tours of duty in Afghanistan on grueling rescue missions to save wounded soldiers on the battlefield. Our squadron lived by a sacred motto:
“These things we do, that others may live.”
And after two tours in Afghanistan, the good people of Montana elected me to the U.S. House of Representatives – I’ve even been endorsed by President Trump TWICE!
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-eBXkS5VVliR2Pk8Ig)
---
But right now, the battlefield has changed – and the stakes have never been higher. I am running for re-election to Congress, and every single seat in these Midterms matters if we want to protect and defend our GOP House Majority.
Peter, I’m not someone who loves asking for money. In fact, it’s one of the hardest parts of this job. But the reality of modern campaigns is that I cannot fight this battle alone. I don’t need a small fortune from a few wealthy insiders – I need a strong team of everyday patriots standing in the trenches with me.
If you believe that Washington needs more leaders who put country over self, and if you want to make sure our House of Representatives stays firmly in conservative hands, I would be deeply grateful for your support.
[If you are able, would you consider making a humble, secure contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today? Every dollar, every CENT goes directly toward defending this seat and keeping our GOP House Majority alive.](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN $25](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN $50](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-d35g)
---
| [CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.emails.troydowning._IsIzwRw)
---
Thank you for your time, your support, and your shared love for this country.
God Bless you,
Troy Downing
U.S. Representative, Montana's 2nd District
---

Peter,
It's now October, which means spooky season has officially begun.
And recent polls have MAGA's ghouls running scared all across the country, as an unprecedented blue tsunami chases in their wake:

---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f2sK-0ufbkwTWQ4ggl-0fQdad4iAVGeOLjODzkurgnKZQj1N7hMspqNSncl2SvJQtGYoA974Da6_lzgZtKUE2GwYNAVTn-M0dNyVMVMULLqyHgXJybv_11CDZhNsQXTSHimY9KXuzfdG0BeTcPjTmvU0jlF7QkZYGXEX0HFv1IsCeyKyW1EI62vIbtdXnesC9iiw_0etm_XqsqkGAcBOjhF6m0XZNHirHvHsEjT3H5w=&c=bfRUUaR4Ultq-AHklILipwdP8FVwFlcNgw3KavgBfosbZArtKjCfSA==&ch=S-P0rKIC8oG_BtpnzGcxBmQ3ifjiz6kEyhgnfML59tOr6gc7LyCPRw==)
---
However, there is one spine-chilling scenario for Democrats.
One where we take back the Senate and House....but quietly lose critical state Supreme Court races down ballot.
Michigan, Montana, and North Carolina all have state Supreme Court elections with massive implications:

* In Michigan, two liberal justices are fighting for their lives to stay on the court. A loss here would pave a path for MAGA to take back the court in coming years.

* In Montana, progressives are attempting to keep their majority on the court in what is considered a deep red state. If MAGA wins, the court flips.

* In North Carolina, Democrats are defending Justice Earls' seat. A win for Democrats here sets up an opportunity to flip the court entirely in 2028.

Losing these races would be so devastating that it could haunt the party for decades.
To make matters scarier, the high-profile Senate and House races are hogging the headlines and the endless TV ads, and these Supreme Court candidates might as well be ghosts.
That is where Defend Our Courts comes in. In the final, frightening stretch of the midterms, we are shining a flashlight into the dark corners of the ballot. We are putting a spotlight on these races and contacting Democratic voters so they know exactly who to vote for.
We have scared off MAGA's court takeovers before. In 2025, we spearheaded the defense of Pennsylvania's Supreme Court. With the help of over 100,000 Democrats nationwide, Pennsylvania's liberal justices kept their majority by landslide margins. We did it again in Wisconsin earlier this year and helped deliver another blowout that sent MAGA running for the exits.
[Losing these races in a blue tsunami election would be a true horror story. We can't let that happen. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Flock Cameras
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Last weekend, I traveled to Ithaca for a Town Hall with students from around the area. There, I was asked about Flock cameras, surveillance, and privacy protections. I want to share my thoughts on those topics with you:
To me privacy means protection from surveillance — whether from the government or from corporations.
**We have to return to the principle that if the government wants to search you, they need to get a warrant.**
**That is why I just introduced a piece of legislation** with Senators Bernie Sanders and Jeff Merkley to ban federal agencies from using automatic license plate readers — otherwise known as Flock cameras.
This bill is a critical first step in our fight to take back our privacy. But Flock cameras are just a piece of a much larger picture when it comes to surveillance and data collection.
Beyond government overreach, companies are selling your data to each other to profit. They are building profiles on each and every one of us from the day that we are born. In fact, even before we are born.
From the moment that they suspect someone is even pregnant, there is often surveillance. And that surveillance is used in determining the prices you pay for things.
Walmart and large companies are now rolling out e-ink price tags, more commonly known as surveillance pricing. Target is rolling out sensors in the baskets that you don't see to build a profile on you.
These companies are sensing everything about you, so that when you go online, the price that you are charged is unique to you. Someone else who goes in can get a completely different price.
This is capitalism in its most extreme form: companies demanding different prices from different people to maximize profits to the detriment of working people.
**We all need to understand these companies are stealing what is yours: your face, your behaviors, your privacy.** We have a right to privacy in the United States of America, and they are violating it and monetizing off of it.
Not only does our right to privacy need to be enforced and protected, but there needs to be forms of surveillance that are not allowed. Surveillance pricing should not be allowed. The idea that Flock cameras even exist is unconscionable.
Your data should be yours. Your privacy should be yours.
When enough of us speak out and demand better, no amount of corporate greed can stop a movement of people who refuse to have their data bought and sold. Our privacy is worth fighting for, and we're going to win it back together.
Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
**One more thing before you click away...**
Alexandria is leading the fight to protect our privacy from corporate greed and recklessness.
The movement she is part of — that we are all part of — doesn’t rely on corporate money. In fact, Alexandria’s campaign is funded by small donations averaging $16.

body:
Our collective action from now til Election Day can impact the outcome of crucial swing races.
#
Hi there,
**We’re officially 30 days out from Election Day. The midterm elections will have a generational impact on the balance of power, and the work we do over the next four weeks will affect control of Congress and many state-level races.**
Across the country, volunteers will be on the ground every day from now til November 3rd, having listening-based persuasion conversations with voters through Ground Truth, Swing Left’s innovative voter contact program. Volunteers will spend time sharing with voters why it’s important to vote in this crucial election. Our goal is to have hundreds of thousands of substantive conversations with voters in key swing districts before polls close on November 3rd.
So far, Swing Left volunteers and organizers have logged tens of thousands of conversations across the country. But over the next few weeks, our field presence needs to multiply rapidly in every priority battleground on our map.
In tight races decided by a few thousand votes, Swing Left volunteers at the doors and on the phones can make a difference in moving voters through authentic conversation.
When Ground Truth canvassers knock on doors, we don’t just read a script. We ask questions and listen to what matters most to voters. By talking with people in the communities that will decide this election, we gather real-time ground insights that help Democratic campaigns respond more to voters' needs and be smarter about their messaging, targeting, and outreach. Campaigns like **Democratic Rep. Greg Landsman’s** in OH-01, where he spent time this week following up with voters who had Ground Truth conversations with volunteers.
With less than 30 days remaining, the conversations we’re having at voters' doorsteps are consequential to winning the House, the Senate, and key state races.
However, scaling up our field operations to reach hundreds of thousands of voters requires continuous, hands-on support. From organizing materials to field staff and volunteer transportation, running a get-out-the-vote program of this scale takes a lot of resources.
[**Will you make a donation of any amount today to support the work volunteers are doing with Ground Truth through Election Day?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl.QSDeHu&refcode=em20261003-3010&t=1&akid=3010%2E1562180%2EOl7lyF)

Thank you for everything you do.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. Volunteers will spend time sharing with voters why it’s important to vote in this crucial election. Our goal is to have hundreds of thousands of substantive conversations with voters in key swing districts before polls close on November 3rd. So far, Swing Left volunteers and organizers have logged tens of thousands of conversations across the country. But over the next few weeks, our field presence needs to multiply rapidly in every priority battleground on our map. In tight races decided by a few thousand votes, Swing Left volunteers at the doors and on the phones can make a difference in moving voters through authentic conversation. When Ground Truth canvassers knock on doors, we don’t just read a script. We ask questions and listen to what matters most to voters. By talking with people in the communities that will decide this election, we gather real-time ground insights that help Democratic campaigns respond more to voters' needs and be smarter about their messaging, targeting, and outreach. Campaigns like Democratic Rep. Greg Landsman’s in OH-01, where he spent time this week following up with voters who had Ground Truth conversations with volunteers. With less than 30 days remaining, the conversations we’re having at voters' doorsteps are consequential to winning the House, the Senate, and key state races. However, scaling up our field operations to reach hundreds of thousands of voters requires continuous, hands-on support. From organizing materials to field staff and volunteer transportation, running a get-out-the-vote program of this scale takes a lot of resources. Thank you for everything you do. — The Swing Left Team Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power. Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. | | | ---|---|---|--- Paid for by Swing Left, , not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: We’ve built a foothold. Now what?
body:
Charlie warned us about this... | | |
---
| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95e739633dcc4843bf9915faecd7f28d&_e=i8Ri_z97KF3_YFzPpyz5d3vxx2TqPyd9_zDyf2Owf6jmPCZH3M9i67viZ8iHAssDozm0mW-il_nXjk-sGucHPqI8t3WpM2CYCoPGHQoFX9MOmNGem0fNfwmACXE4mhF3xZHhwO7pmctEv4HfbUUFJ6Ct0bSFMSJCF7SWxh38X1Fi8f3teiE9SCxxMTo7RzCNNboKw2g2fUEwYMxWCCb2ZGjoedrJZkC-E4I-sao2zq8bs5RshZV1hdRyE6rDxay7YhFDdriS1Qr_F5XnP3j_PN2pxScbxSfOIoSq8EtzOUE5uSo8X-dXadVNACpzTxpHAf1OdzPsWIUhD4Fz7Dxiv1S5D7yxYm9BlxONUc0ID8EMftVp5Uh0YHPhKgNPrJJuCl2GDxqIkHXj1GUqIeqDjBtj1igOpvd8QJEVX9ptAurqP483c8RiB5N8lGNGZhzViysW9qVCVFFGi7FKIs13R-kZHxFWlXQ2uYtrs605v1znZPMqO3B-I1gBAUk-0hVOYtCJeU-sTKQUqi_fFlVAEEUq-7iuMhtUIQX4k7-v1wPsXGOWeuqtPNSWZDS3T5ceHQw7YBdmKx4R815tH-AeQw9Md4IUQlCF6MyFelNZip1pKon1OngZhyvxFB4OC2ucRZ4ahQknCZtdFL8x7Oi2Q6oHvjeXDnYdqfQo_lW3usNDK4aDIui2SahqwCoUvd0awIDS8DGQncXNzXA-NydHeQWmvJxZTRWwKUVP7AEXcPo%3D)
---
And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

**[And Peter, I’m asking you to send backup to these brave students on the frontlines with your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95e739633dcc4843bf9915faecd7f28d&_e=i8Ri_z97KF3_YFzPpyz5d3vxx2TqPyd9_zDyf2Owf6jmPCZH3M9i67viZ8iHAssDozm0mW-il_nXjk-sGucHPqI8t3WpM2CYCoPGHQoFX9MOmNGem0fNfwmACXE4mhF3xZHhwO7pmctEv4HfbUUFJ6Ct0bSFMSJCF7SWxh38X1Fi8f3teiE9SCxxMTo7RzCNNboKw2g2fUEwYMxWCCb2ZGjoedrJZkC-E4I-sao2zq8bs5RshZV1hdRyE6rDxay77_gmjz4POj5-GaaR2mg3CuxXc-TIV0m1s2nVRBNgRlkIsbViNYIi4qEuCsqoRpzx5Ghenm40dCJj6SNOrJhuB_B_zMpejc1p1mlf-k7URbQl3BcrAuB_Tpr09uYao6xmnTEsKpCpDPX-BB_oIUpHQoWbzZ26FCYY8v_74ShAqEjA8BV3oy5A0ltyMZfvehCPtTsjFw0HFbM-D3yx5uLzhn_xGB-I7W8ueK9HhQfny92kRzsbW4-Lng4XXsEe-TGkV1V-D6z3ZFtnF66Hf5ZtekQ6oySjbLcTqcpXY0acsimEgRI-oH0KTWGdEYmzh6B8I12uyqy3JfrRVvZg_0ZQ4xxmp-pY0RHs7q_Sa47HJ_z6IcRVYw59goAN-pZthI3k8z0KhSQarwAuLoWNBKh8-uWT-UtMXtaSiljkxNRsTIO8fNE5Hg2R-KNW8xzdzi9GfYces4X15EoRKIw13DUOlLsZ3wUQYsti6YdS8YFsxlQ%3D)**

Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Our group included myself, my friend [Aalia Mauro](https://open.substack.com/users/28561554-aalia-mauro?utm_source=mentions), former Congresswoman [Cori Bush](https://open.substack.com/users/332986252-cori-bush?utm_source=mentions), her husband, and several others. You can watch that interview [here](https://substack.com/redirect/31bafddf-71f5-4798-9e52-799361ecf791?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

# They Came for Mustafa Zaatar in the Middle of the Night
Mustafa Zaatar was still shaken when we met him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d27a27d-af13-415c-9595-34ab505875f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Mustafa Zaatar, 78, holds his American passport in front of one of his vehicles vandalized by Israeli settler terrorists in the West Bank, Gaza. Zaatar is an American citizen living in the West Bank. Photo by Rebekah Jones.
The Palestinian American, 78, sat with our delegation less than eight hours after the attack, and described what it was like to watch a mob descend on his home and land. The attack was over, but it clearly had not left him.
His fields had been burned. Cars torched. His tractor damaged. Windows smashed. Mustafa told us roughly 150 Israeli attackers had descended on his property. He described waiting for help while the destruction continued around him.
This was his home.
Mustafa has been an American citizen since 1976. He had spent decades building a life that stretched between the United States and Palestine, only to find himself sitting before a group of visiting Americans trying to explain what it feels like to be terrorized on your own land, and to wonder whether the country whose passport you carry is willing to protect you.
There is something particularly cruel about violence against a home. A home is supposed to be the place where fear stops at the door. Burn the fields around it, smash its windows, torch the cars outside, and the message is difficult to misunderstand:
**You are not safe here.**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/71e111e0-19bc-443e-9b15-0db02911f5d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At about 1:30 in the morning on September 27, Israeli attackers entered Abu Falah, east of Ramallah. Mustafa was asleep inside his home.
Soon, everything outside was burning.
Three vehicles were set on fire. Mustafa rushed to shut the doors as he and his wife tried to understand what was happening outside. Footage taken afterward documented the burned vehicles. Mustafa separately told Anadolu that dozens of armed Israelis had surrounded his home and vandalized the property.
Neighbors eventually confronted the attackers and helped extinguish the fires.
Photos from Mustafa Zaatar's home after the Israeli terrorist attack. Photos by Rebekah Jones.
Imagine being 78 years old, inside your own home in the middle of the night, watching your property burn.
Now imagine carrying an American passport and wondering whether it means anything at all.
"I am an American citizen," Mustafa said afterward, "but I have not felt that it protected me or offered me anything."
His relatives in the United States contacted American consular officials. Mustafa asked American officials to come see what had been done to his home.
But there is something Americans need to understand about what is happening in the West Bank: the violence cannot be separated from the land.
That became impossible for me to ignore while traveling there.
We met Palestinians who described being afraid to reach their own agricultural land. We traveled roads whose accessibility depended on who was trying to use them. We encountered gates and closures capable of turning a short trip between neighboring communities into a long detour -- or preventing it altogether. We stood overlooking agricultural land that residents told us they could no longer safely reach.
And we met people like Mustafa.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0c5f7d1b-c2e2-44ce-8f44-921d222fcbc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A family frightened out of its home loses more than a building. A farmer who cannot safely reach his olive trees loses more than a harvest. Close a gate. Block a road. Threaten a family. Burn a field. Destroy a tractor. Make the journey to someone's own land dangerous enough, often enough, and eventually geography itself begins to change.
Fear becomes a border. Violence becomes a land-use policy.
The question goes beyond who formally owns a piece of land and becomes: who can actually reach it, live on it, farm it, travel across it and return safely home?
That is why what happened to Mustafa cannot be treated as another isolated act of violence. And it is why legislation introduced in Congress just days after this latest attack matters.
Reps. Joaquin Castro, Madeleine Dean, Don Beyer, Greg Casar, Sara Jacobs, Veronica Escobar and other House Democrats introduced the **[Stop the Settlements Act](https://substack.com/redirect/751bb1c6-f374-4e20-8599-dafc70b953fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , legislation aimed at the continued establishment and expansion of Israeli settlements and outposts.
The bill would require sanctions against foreign individuals and entities involved in establishing or expanding settlements and outposts in the occupied West Bank and would prohibit imports into the United States of goods produced in those settlements and outposts.
Whatever happens to the bill in Congress, its premise addresses something that becomes painfully obvious once you stand on the land yourself: violence, movement, and territorial control are intertwined.
Mustafa understands that better than most.
He has watched people come for his land. He has watched his property burn. He has watched American citizenship fail to keep violence from reaching his front door.
And still, at 78 years old, he refuses to be frightened away.
"They are trying to force us off our land," Mustafa said after the latest attack. "We will stay here. We will not leave."
That sentence stayed with me.
Because our delegation eventually packed our bags. We crossed checkpoints. We boarded planes.
We left Palestine and came home.
That's not possible for many Americans in the West Bank.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b7214c71-8f27-4cff-85db-41a9d9b31f41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At least nine Americans have been killed in the West Bank since 2022 in incidents involving Israeli security forces or Israeli attackers, [according to a Senate resolution](https://substack.com/redirect/6f50e280-e7c3-47e3-b236-bb027b314758?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) introduced this year seeking answers about their deaths. _That Senate resolution[ failed 47-53](https://substack.com/redirect/9a135c1a-197f-4848-aefe-746faba18d02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the day I returned home._
Palestinian Americans like Mustafa are still alive to tell us what is happening to them, but how many times should they have to?
Mustafa should not have to watch another car burn. He should not have to wonder whether armed men will return in the middle of another night. He should not have to prove, again and again, that an American citizen deserves protection simply because that American is Palestinian.
His home is still there.
His land is still there.
His olive trees are still there.
And Mustafa is still there.
At 78 years old, after everything that has already happened, he refuses to surrender the place he calls home.
The question now belongs to every one of our representatives in Congress:
What is an American passport worth when the American holding it is Palestinian?

| | | | [](https://trk.email.tedcruz.-5ZSaVZ0mgxlW9eA)
---
| | | Fellow Conservative, I just sat down with Sean Hannity, and I said something I need every conservative in this country to hear. **[WATCH: Cruz on the most consequential midterms of our lifetime](https://trk.email.tedcruz.)**
---
[](https://trk.email.tedcruz._wwpg)

subject: A couple of urgent updates

---
Peter, we have a couple of urgent updates to share with you.
First, North Carolinians will start heading to the polls in just 12 days. Some folks reading this now may have absentee ballots sitting on the kitchen counter already.
Many people are still making up their minds – but they aren’t waiting until Nov. 3 to decide. They’re choosing who they want to represent NC in the U.S. Senate _right now._
That’s why grassroots support from people like you is so critical in these final weeks of the election. Every day we don’t get in front of these voters is a day the GOP does it for us. Republicans are blanketing the airwaves with nearly $100 million in attack ads against Roy – spreading lies about him – and millions of folks are seeing these ads as we speak.
**Second, our pre-general FEC fundraising deadline is coming up fast. It’s our final FEC deadline that will publicly show the grassroots strength of this campaign.** On Oct. 14 at midnight, every federal campaign has to close their books and prepare to report their numbers to the Federal Election Commission one final time.
If we’re able to file a strong report, we‘ll show the power of this grassroots movement – and we can convince MAGA megadonors that their money is better spent elsewhere. If our numbers look weak, the GOP will double down on their money and attacks to ensure our defeat.
**_That means your donation of $5 today does two jobs at once:_**
1. It helps put Roy’s message in front of voters deciding how to cast their ballots.
2. It raises the number on our FEC report, telling the MAGA billionaires betting against us to think again.
[**_We need you with us, Peter. If you can, will you chip in $5 or more right now to help Roy win in North Carolina? We’re running out of time to sway undecided voters, fight back against the GOP’s attacks and flip this seat blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1581&amount=5&t=8&akid=4173%2E124072%2EQuMx3R)

Peter, It's hard to believe, but we're just a month away from Election Day. This is an exciting time as we make our final case to voters across the Central Valley, but it's going to be tough. **California voters start to receive mail-in ballot on MONDAY, so we can't rely on turnout on November 3rd. As far as we're concerned, every day voters have a ballot in hand is Election Day.** That's why our team is working around the clock to reach every undecided voter through ads, mail, phone calls, and conversations at their doors. **[Right now we need 500 ballot chasers](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e708627/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfbXQtb3RvY2hfYnJfMjAyNjEwMDIv/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDM/LbmNsWjFOdHdkTQ/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM2ODhfd3IyJmFtb3VudD0xMDA/gasEsDg/sfke1ff10dc)** funded and deployed in the 8 critical states we have to win this midterm cycle.

**This is it. This is the biggest moment in recent political history.**

**[Help us keep Charlie’s mission alive and turn September’s momentum into November’s victory.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e708627/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfbXQtb3RvY2hfYnJfMjAyNjEwMDIv/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDM/LbmNsWjFOdHdkTQ/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM2ODhfd3IyJmFtb3VudD0xMDA/gasEsDg/sfke1ff10dc)**

"My classmate Jane continues to call me James, which was my name before I transitioned."
Freedom of speech is still the law of the land in the United States, but on college campuses, that is apparently up for interpretation.
Look no further than the University of California and its sprawling system of 10 campuses, 300,000 students a year, across the state. One set of policies and standards governs all of its campuses, and with it comes a ban on "misgendering" -- and on adhering to biological reality.
That sentence above? It isn't from a student's complaint. It's from the University of California's own mandatory training, quoted in a federal court ruling -- and it helped sink the university's policy in court.

| | | | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=334754621c5849fc84992e43a36bf637&_e=9lg7wfmx4r6TcFkb-g84AUhQLYuTPTk-CshrKE0gyf7krP_-BhyEXfvDiaiPkw2cGHem9Lyns6HvxWtMJtLCJJ7i0aldUKg9T5Dk8WauYKqQ-TTUMUaOqMHCq83rJdq7mSAVV_93WfHmTpa3t_YY73SwOC9iDrYbmRBMdfwgpRiFawONhIa75LqLkHaJ0IozDTUZeepuFCULKiXOhsdfD24q6B0DB-RrRyXnRaGPVE3xlPVSmvwGRc0-o47r9iGZ0qzVuxtfIsFoAaLUOfVWxpH5eTWdAobrh3LV0TYq_CJK4mHVIR9mDPeku5b_ENTmcnKWrXEboptfcCes7PIOPMcy7NrGu7H3Zhn4uJcQNlJsR0XzGItQCClxzCftI8PsvuTPFTorBcP96mE6JOj4Wbu39c7cAQsMPSkLDDzd48X25CGsK5V17-7o9DKlZCwNZaN0vry9yRpKQKzjeGIiuCt4HAgofLll_8ev_pW2OzgDSq_-5Ixlfag4xHZmq4jdg30VnjKa6sv2qfOxbQfiv80HeLEHN4MyxcdCRsU8MEFXQkGy1BVcnsQ2i-8WzVT8ccgD5o5rF5J9RBovGw7Lk6ZcIBBL_Dq8ysesJqu9jh4%3D)

I represent Ohio's 15th Congressional District. And thirty days from today, America votes on three things that every conservative in this country needs to understand. Republicans hold it by two seats. The DCCC has targeted districts like mine all year to flip that number and hand the gavel to Hakeem Jeffries. Lose it, and Day 1 means investigations into President Trump, tax cuts threatened, and the SAVE Act buried. The border. American energy. Tax relief for working families. Everything delivered over the last two years is protected by a Republican Majority and reversed by a Democrat one. The DSA has over 100,000 members. They beat three sitting House Democrats in primaries this cycle. There are 11 openly socialist candidates on the November ballot running on Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, and the Green New Deal. We are one month out from Election Day - let's finish strong!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/uqyKtlh0uZn?e=1c5f08419c&c2id=9f711ebcee4618a2092828a4c98e410a)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

### **It’s October 3rd, which means we are just one month out from Election Day. We’re within striking distance, but we still have a lot to do before November 3rd, and we need your support now more than ever to finish this race strong.**

**If you’ve been wanting to get involved but don’t know where to start, please consider signing up for a doorknocking shift, and bringing a friend or family member with you! Knocking doors with my daughter in 2024 was my first venture into political volunteering, and I would encourage you to get out there and get involved, because in this moment we can’t just sit back – we need to stand up for our communities, and for our democracy.**
**Sign up on my website or check out the links below to get involved, whether that’s knocking doors, making phone calls, or putting a Team Eileen sign in your front yard.**
**Now, for an update on what I was up to in September!**
---
| |
### Best, Eileen.

| | From the beginning, my favorite part of the campaign has been getting to travel across the district and meet with so many of you. It is so energizing getting to speak with so many people face-to-face and listen to what they want from their next representative, and I had such a wonderful time getting to different community events across the district in September. Whether in Sterling for **Sugar Beet Days,** Haxtun for the **Haxtun Corn Festival,** or Highlands Ranch for **Highlands Ranch Oktoberfest,** those moments of connection are so meaningful, and I am already looking forward to attending those same events next year.
I continue to hear from people across the district that the cost of living is out of control, and that people are increasingly strained. So many people feel let down by out-of-touch politicians who aren’t focused on solving real problems that so many Americans experience, and this was clear to me when I volunteered at the **Weld Food Bank** for the third time. Each time I’m there I see the needs continuing to grow. Hardworking families are having to make tough choices about what they can afford, and we need politicians who work hard to bring down the cost of everyday goods and make the American Dream a reality. I also met with the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless**** and toured their **Sage Ridge Supportive Residential Community** , and I was so inspired by the hard work they are doing to help people overcome challenges, develop stability, obtain educational and work experience, and transition into living and working on their own. We must work to ensure there is affordable housing and a wealth of job opportunities for Colorado residents, and in Congress, that will be one of my top priorities.
September was a month full of doorknocking, and I’m proud to say that my field team has knocked 32,148 doors so far. We’ve been canvassing in every corner of the district, from **Phillips County** to **Douglas County,** and we’ve been able to connect with so many voters who are feeling dissatisfied and want something new. I know I’ll be able to give them the serious, common-sense representation they so desperately want, but one of the biggest challenges ahead is getting to the 30,000 more doors we still have to knock. Please consider getting involved and taking a canvassing shift to get our message out to voters across CD4, so I can bring down costs and make life better for the people of this district.

"_Life experiences have to influence you. We are not robots_ " Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor 2009 confirmation hearings
"_We do not have Obama judges or Trump judges, Bush judges or Clinton judges_ " Chief Justice John Roberts November 2018
Over the past six years, the American judiciary has undergone a significant demographic transformation. Since 2020, the number of black federal judges has climbed steadily, with roughly 172 black jurists now actively serving or recently confirmed--representing approximately 11.8% of the federal bench, up from 9.5% in 2020. When including judges who identify as multiracial or partially black, that number rises to about 184. At the highest level, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson occupies a seat on the U.S. Supreme Court as the first black woman in the institution's history. In state courts, roughly 18% of supreme court justices nationwide are people of color.
There is no single official registry yet tabulating every appointment by exact calendar year, but the major research outfits have tracked the appointments closely. Here is what the data show:
The Biden administration (January 2021-January 2025) is the period that drives virtually all the diversity surge since 2020. According to Pew Research Center, President Biden appointed 228 federal judges in his single term. Multiple sources, including a Barack Obama social-media post citing White House figures, indicate that roughly 62 percent of Biden's confirmed judges were women--or about 141 women out of 228. Biden set records across the board for demographic firsts: he also appointed more Hispanic women and Asian women than any prior president.

When things get tough, Iowans get tougher, and we know it's not over till it's over.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586140/650960987/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDdmZTVlMC00YmJmLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_oXl0hjuowdSHXCa7_lsZd4_mtZkQcjxFY4vvEA6fiY=)

Peter,

Last Saturday, I was reviewing some of our campaign numbers, and I had the Iowa game playing on my phone. I just couldn't miss our Hawkeyes taking on Michigan in the Big House. Time ticked by and the scoreboard wasn't getting any better, but I know my Hawks, and I know they don't back down.

Then, with just 2 seconds left, an amazing drive ended with Hank Brown delivering a last-second touchdown pass to Reece Vander Zee, resulting in one of the BIGGEST collegiate football upsets of 2026. After going back and forth the entire game, the Hawkeyes pulled off our first win against Michigan since 2016 in a last-second 20-19 victory!

**I don't know how loud I cheered at that moment, but I wouldn't be surprised if my neighbors heard it...**

A lot of people counted out the Hawkeyes going into last week's game. A lot of people are counting them out going into today's game against Ohio State. _A lot of people are counting us out, especially since we're going up against Mariannette Miller-Meeks' well-funded political machine._

When things get tough, Iowans get tougher, and we know it's not over till it's over. Just like the Hawkeyes, we can't let that get in our heads. I came into this race taking nothing for granted, and I'm committed to fighting with everything I've got until polls close in just one month.

Election Day is one month from today. On Monday, ballots start going out to every registered voter in CA-45, and my name will be on them. For a lot of people, this next month is the first time they'll really sit down and think about who represents them. Before that happens, I'd like you to know a little more about who I am and where I come from. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586508/650962090/439559405?refcode=em-10.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWFlZmE0MDktNGNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pYdTCa_RzAtBX7UDF5LA-FdudKwM2rL0rLFDQ4zXLGA=) I'm the son of Vietnamese refugees. After the Fall of Saigon, my parents spent a year in a refugee camp before they made it to the United States. When they got here, they started over with almost nothing, and for a while our family relied on food stamps and Medicaid to get by. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586509/650962091/439559405?refcode=em-10.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWFlZmE0MDktNGNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pYdTCa_RzAtBX7UDF5LA-FdudKwM2rL0rLFDQ4zXLGA=) Eventually, my parents opened a corner store in Southern California. I spent my summers behind the register there, and that's where I learned what hard work looks like. My parents opened early and closed late, and they treated every customer like a neighbor, because most of them were. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586510/650962092/439559405?refcode=em-10.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWFlZmE0MDktNGNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pYdTCa_RzAtBX7UDF5LA-FdudKwM2rL0rLFDQ4zXLGA=) America gave my family a chance, and I wanted to give something back. So at 18, I enlisted in the Army. That's the story I want voters to remember when they open their ballots this month. **[Getting it in front of them takes money we have to raise now, so if you can chip in, I'd be grateful for whatever you're able to give.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586511/650962093/439559405?refcode=em-10.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWFlZmE0MDktNGNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pYdTCa_RzAtBX7UDF5LA-FdudKwM2rL0rLFDQ4zXLGA=)** | **[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140586512/650962113/439559405?refcode=em-10.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWFlZmE0MDktNGNiZi1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pYdTCa_RzAtBX7UDF5LA-FdudKwM2rL0rLFDQ4zXLGA=)**

| | | 🫡 Snapping a Salute Instead of Snapping Judgment

🪦 During a veteran’s tour of the American Cemetery at Normandy in 2010, the tour guide described the proper flag folding procedure after lowering the flag over such hallowed ground. A young man named Salvatore Giunta listened intently. After the instruction, an older man wearing a Korea War Veteran hat walked over and asked Salvatore:

!?️ “Don’t you know how to fold an American flag?”

!!️ Salvatore responded simply and respectfully: “Yes, sir, I do.”

🤔 There was a long pause to follow as a part of the apparent standoff between the older man and the younger one. The leader of the group walked up to the Korean veteran and said these words that put the qualifications of the younger man into crystal clear perspective:

🇺🇲 “Sir, I would like you to meet Staff Sergeant Salvatore Giunta to whom President Obama is going to present the Medal of Honor.”

💥 The older veteran who had judged the younger man by his mere youthful appearance was rightfully humbled. He immediately snapped a salute to Salvatore, quickly reorienting himself and showing the proper respect to one who deserved far more than a negative snap judgment.

🔥 It’s a great reminder for all of us to be far more inclined to snap a salute than snapping judgment.

🙏 Thanks to Martha Raddatz for this great story from her new book “The Hero Next Door”

| | | It’s tough to believe that it’s been 30 years since I graduated Air Force pilot training!
The jets have been cool, but the gal still on my arm is even better!
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEcDi1QiaMFOpU26ddzgW/YbYuk--NKuyY)
---
The actual full name of the president’s airfield outside Washington, DC is Joint Base Andrews – Naval Air Facility Washington. Most just call it Joint Base Andrews (or JBA), though Team Teichert likes pronouncing the proper acronym (JBA-NAFW). You’ll have to ask us how to say it.
While it is an Air Force led base, the Navy Skipper plays a significant role on the leadership team. The Skipper during a big part of my time there was Captain Scott “Sparkj” Fuller. He was awesome.
And though I’m a Naval Academy fan, during the week of the Air Force – Navy football game, we put on a pretty good show on base with me publicly supporting the Air Force Academy. We even wrestled in front of the base community in large sumo suits to add a goofy dose of excitement to the mix (I hope those videos never emerge)!
Sparkj and I went to the game together too, but by then I was fully rooting for the Naval Academy (2017). And it was glorious when Navy won in the last minute with a touchdown in the endzone right in front of us.
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF4YQDr6wSAZ5XrUScjOa/8A3pc9AU1Kxu)
---
✈ Plan for contingencies – a ground test that I took airborne

🗓 On October 19th, 2005, I was in the cockpit for the final ground test of the F-22 hook. I was to hit the cable halfway down the runway at a specific weight and speed to verify the edge of the envelope for the Raptor arresting system. Unexpectedly, the design of the hook was not up to the task.

📣 As a flight test team, we had planned for contingencies. We had briefed to those contingencies, and we had to execute to those contingencies.

🎤 We had a crew at the cable who would radio if we missed the cable – bolter, bolter, bolter (normally a Navy term on a carrier). We had determined that with a missed cable it would be far safer at that speed, weight, and position on the runway to take it airborne then try to stop. And that’s what we did – safely!

🎙 The engineers went to work on what happened, and after a hook redesign and other ground tests that went as planned, the Raptor would have a fully capable hook. Yet, that ground test would have ended far differently if the team hadn’t thought through the things that weren’t expected to go wrong, but could and did!

!? What contingencies should you and your team be planning for?
Rejoin Opportunities
This coming month, I will be at speaking at the annual Liberty University CEO Summit (Lynchburg, VA, October 7-8).
Dad Jokes of the Month
A few nights ago, I wrote a bunch of mathematical equations on my wife’s head while she was sleeping.
When she woke up, you should have seen the expression on her face.
| | | |
---
| | | | **Teichert in the Trenches**
